Mukama teyandikkirizza ekiweebwayo kino ku lwaffe, ne yeewaayo n'atusalira omusango tufe. Mukama tasobola kusoma kusonyiyibwa kwaffe okwawandiikibwa mu musaayi gw'Omwana we, ne oluvannyuma n'atukuba. Ekyo kyali kitasoboka. Singa oweebwa ekisa amangwago okutunula eri Yesu n'okutandika ku ntandikwa, ku Yesu, ye Nsulo y'ekisa eri omuntu omuzza-musango! "Aweesa obutuukirivu atali mutuukirivu." "Ye Katonda aweesa obutuukirivu," kyekivudde, era olw'ensonga eyo yokka kisoboka okukolebwa, era akikola ng'ayita mu ssaddaaka ey'okutangirira ey'Omwana we ow'obwa Katonda. Noolwekyo kiyinza okukolebwa mu bwenkanya--mu bwenkanya obungi nnyo nga tewali n'omu aliddayo okukibuusabuusa--nga kikoleddwa okutuukirira nti ku lunaku olw'entiisa olusembayo, eggulu n'ensi bwe biriggwaawo, tewaliba n'omu aliwakanya obutuufu bw'okuweebwa obutuukirivu. "Ani oyo asalira omusango? Kristo ye yafa. Ani anaawawaabira abalonde ba Katonda? Katonda ye aweesa obutuukirivu." Kaakano, ggwe mmeeme enaku! onoojja mu lyato lino ery'okulokola, nga bw'oli? Wano waliwo obukuumi okuva mu kwonooneka! Kkiriza okuwonyezebwa okukakafu. "Sirina kantu ne kimu," bw'ogamba. Tosabibwa kuleeta kantu konna. Abantu abadduka okuwonya obulamu bwabwe baleka n'engoye zaabwe emabega. Buuka, nga bw'oli. Nnaakubuulira ekintu kino ekikwata ku nze okukugumya. Essuubi lyange lyokka ery'eggulu liri mu kutangirira okujjuvu okwakolebwa ku musaalaba gwa Kalvali ku lw'abatali batuukirivu. Ku ekyo kwe nneesigama n'obunywevu. Sirina n'akasiikirize k'essuubi mu kifo kirala kyonna. Oli mu mbeera y'emu nga nze; kubanga ffembi tetulina kantu kaffe ak'omuwendo ng'omusingi gw'okwesiga. Ka tukwatagane emikono ne tuyimirira wamu ku makkati g'omusaalaba, era twesige emmeeme zaffe omulundi gumu ogw'olubereberye eri oyo eyayiwa omusaayi gwe ku lw'abazza-emisango. Tunaalokolebwa Omulokozi omu era ye oyo omu. Bw'onoozikirira ng'omwesiga, nange nteekwa kuzikirira. Kiki kye nnyinza okukola ekirala okukakasa obwesige bwange mu njiri gye nkuteekera mu maaso?

fields.title: Ku Kuwonyezebwa okuva mu Kwonoona
fields.body_html:
OKUWONYEZEBWA OKUVA MU KWONOONA

Mu kifo kino njagala njogere ekigambo kimu oba bibiri ebyangu eri abo abategeera engeri y'okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza okuli mu Kristo Yesu, naye ekibaluma kiri nti tebasobola kulekeraawo kwonoona. Tetuyinza kuba basanyufu, abawummudde, oba abalamu mu mwoyo okutuusa lwe tufuuka abatukuvu. Kitugwanira okuggibwako ekibi; naye okuggyibwako okwo kunaakolebwa kutya? Kino kye kibuuzo eky'obulamu oba okufa eri bangi. Obuzaaliranwa obukadde bwa maanyi nnyo, era bagezezzaako okubuziyiza n'okubugonza; naye tebugonda, ne beesanga, wadde nga baagala okuba abalungi, beeyongera okuba ababi okusinga bwe baali edda. Omutima muzibu nnyo, n'okwagala kukakanyavu nnyo, n'enneewulira ez'amaanyi zibuubuuka nnyo, n'ebirowoozo bikyukakyuka nnyo, n'okulowooza tekufugika, n'okwegomba kwa buzira nnyo, olwo omuntu yeewulira nti alina empuku y'ensolo enkambwe munda ye, ezinaamulya nga tezinnamugondera. Tuyinza okwogera ku buzaaliranwa bwaffe obwagwa nga Mukama bwe yagamba Yobu ku Leviyasani: “Onoomuzannyisa ng'akanyonyi? oba onoomusibira abazaana bo?” Omuntu ayinza okusuubira okukwata empewo ey'obukiikakkono mu ngalo ze, nga bw'asuubira okufuga n'amaanyi ge ye obuyinza obw'akavuyo obubeera mu buzaaliranwa bwe obwagwa. Kino kikolwa kya maanyi okusinga emirimu gyonna egy'engero eza Herukulesi: wano Katonda ye yeetaagibwa.

“Nnandisobodde okukkiriza nti Yesu ayinza okusonyiwa ekibi,” bw'ayogera omu, “naye ekindeetera obuzibu kiri nti nzeeyongera kwonoona, era mpulira ng'endowooza embi ez'amaanyi ziri munda yange. Ng'ejjinja bwe liri, bwe likanyugibwa mu bbanga, mangu ago liddayo wansi ku ttaka, era nange bwe ntyo, wadde nga ntumibwa waggulu mu ggulu olw'okubuulira okw'amaanyi, nziza mu mbeera yange ey'obutawulira. Zzikoona! Nkwatibwa mangu amaaso g'ekibi agalooga, ne nsibibwa ng'ali mu ddogo, ne siyinza kudduka busiru bwange.”

Munnange omwagalwa, obulokozi bwandibadde kya nnaku ekitajjuvu singa tekikwatako kitundu kino eky'obulamu bwaffe obwayonoonebwa. Twagala okulongoosebwa era n'okusonyiyibwa. Okuweebwa obutuukirivu awatali kutukuzibwa tekyandibadde bulokozi n'akatono. Kyandiyise omugenge nga mulongoofu, ne kimuleka afe endwadde ye; kyandisonyiye obujeemu ne kikkiriza omujeemu okusigala mulabe wa kabaka we. Kyandiggyeewo ebivaamu naye ne kirekayo ensonga, ne kino kyanditulesse n'omulimu ogutaggwaawo era ogutaliiko ssuubi. Kyandiyimirizza omugga okumala akaseera, naye ne kireka oluzzi olw'obucaafu nga luggule, olwandivuddemu oluvannyuma n'amaanyi amangi. Jjukira nti Mukama Yesu yajja okuggyawo ekibi mu ngeri ssatu; yajja okuggyawo ekibonerezo ky'ekibi, n'amaanyi g'ekibi, era ekisembayo, okubaawo kw'ekibi. Amangwago oyinza okutuuka ku kitundu ekyokubiri--amaanyi g'ekibi gayinza okumenyebwa amangu ago; era bw'otyo onooba oli mu kkubo eridda ku kyokusatu, kwe kuggyawo okubaawo kw'ekibi. “Tumanyi nti yalabisibwa alyoke aggyewo ebibi byaffe.”

Malayika yayogera ku Mukama waffe nti, “Olimutuuma erinnya lye Yesu, kubanga y'alirokola abantu be okuva mu bibi byabwe.” Mukama waffe Yesu yajja okuzikiriza mu ffe emirimu gya Setaani. Ekyayogerwa ku kuzaalibwa kwa Mukama waffe era kyalangirirwa mu kufa kwe; kubanga omuserikale bwe yafumita omubavu gwe, amangwago ne muvaamu omusaayi n'amazzi, okulaga eddagala ery'emirundi ebiri lye tuwonyezebwa omusango n'obucaafu bw'ekibi.

Naye bw'oba oteganyizibwa amaanyi g'ekibi, n'endowooza ez'obuzaaliranwa bwo, nga bw'oyinza okuba, laba wano waliwo kisuubizo eri ggwe. Kikkirize, kubanga kiyimiridde mu ndagaano eyo ey'ekisa etegekeddwa mu bintu byonna era enywevu. Katonda, atayinza kulimba, ayogedde mu Ezeekyeri 36:26:

Era ndibawa omutima omuggya, era ndissa omwoyo omuggya munda yammwe: era ndiggya omutima ogw'ejjinja mu mubiri gwammwe, era ndibawa omutima ogw'ennyama.

Olaba, kyonna kiri nti “Ndikola,” era “Ndikola.” “Ndiwa,” era “Ndiggyawo.” Eno y'engeri ey'obwakabaka eya Kabaka wa bakabaka, asobola okutuukiriza byonna by'ayagala. Tewali kigambo kye ekineegwa wansi.

Mukama amanyi bulungi nti toyinza kukyusa mutima gwo ggwe, era toyinza kutukuza buzaaliranwa bwo; naye era amanyi nti ye asobola byombi. Asobola okuleetera Omuwesiya okukyusa olususu lwe, n'engo okukyusa amabala gaayo. Wuliriza kino, weewuunye: asobola okukutonda omulundi ogwokubiri; asobola okukuleetera okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Kino kyamagero eky'ekisa, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu y'alikikola. Kyandibadde kya kwewuunya nnyo singa omuntu yeyimiridde ku ntobo y'Amazzi Agagwa aga Niagara, n'ayogera ekigambo ekyandireese omugga Niagara okutandika okukulukuta nga gwambuka, ne gubuuka ku lwazi luli oluwanvu kwe gukulukutira kaakano n'amaanyi amangi ennyo. Tewali kirala wabula amaanyi ga Katonda agandisobodde okukola ekyamagero ekyo; naye ekyo kyandisinze okwenkanankana n'ekyandibaddewo singa olugendo lw'obuzaaliranwa bwo lukyusibwa ddala. Byonna bisoboka eri Katonda. Asobola okukyusa oludda okwegomba kwo n'okukulukuta kw'obulamu bwo, era mu kifo ky'okuserengeta okuva ku Katonda, asobola okuleetera omuntu wo yenna okwambuka nga yeeyongera okusemberera Katonda. Ekyo, mu mazima, kye Mukama kye yasuubiza okukolera bonna abali mu ndagaano; era tumanyi okuva mu Byawandiikibwa nti abakkiriza bonna bali mu ndagaano. Ka nsome ebigambo nate:

Era ndissa omwoyo omuggya munda yammwe: era ndiggya omutima ogw'ejjinja mu mubiri gwammwe, era ndibawa omutima ogw'ennyama. (Ezeekyeri 11:19).

Nga kino kisuubizo kya kitalo! Era kiri weewaawo era amiina mu Kristo Yesu ku kitiibwa kya Katonda okuyita mu ffe. Ka tukinyweze; tukikkirize nga kya mazima, era tukyefunire ffe. Olwo kirituukirizibwa mu ffe, era ku nnaku n'emyaka egigenda okujja, tulyimba ku nkyukakyuka eyo ey'ekitalo ekisa kya Katonda ekifuga bye kikoze mu ffe.

Kigwanira nnyo okulowoozebwako nti Mukama bw'aggyawo omutima ogw'ejjinja, ekikolwa ekyo kikoleddwa; era bwe kimala okukolebwa, tewali maanyi gamanyiddwa agayinza okuggyawo omutima omuggya ogwo gw'awa, n'omwoyo omulungi ogwo gw'assa munda yaffe. “Eby'ekisa n'okuyita kwa Katonda tebiriimu kwejjusa”; kwe kugamba, awatali kwejjusa ku ludda lwe; taggyawo kye yali awadde. Muleke akuzze buggya nga bw'olizzibwa obuggya. Okwenenya kw'omuntu n'okwelongoosa kumala bwangu okukoma, kubanga embwa eddayo ku biseseme byayo; naye Katonda bw'assa omutima omuggya mu ffe, omutima omuggya guba wo emirembe gyonna, era teguddayo nate kukaluba ng'ejjinja. Oyo eyagufuula ennyama y'aligukuuma bw'atyo. Mu kino tuyinza okusanyuka n'okujaguza emirembe gyonna mu ekyo Katonda ky'atonda mu bwakabaka bw'ekisa kye.

Okwogera ensonga eno mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo--wali owuliddeko ku kigero kya Mr. Rowland Hill eky'akkapa n'embizzi enkazi? Ndikyogera mu ngeri yange, okunnyonnyola ebigambo bya Mulokozi waffe eby'amaanyi--“Kibagwanira okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.” Olaba akkapa ako? Nga kitonde ekiyonjo! Nga bwe kanaaba obulungi n'olulimi lwako n'ebigere byako! Kya kulabako kya kitalo! Wali olabyeko embizzi enkazi ng'ekola bwe kityo? Nedda, tewali. Kiri okukontana n'obuzaaliranwa bwayo. Yeeyagalira okwevulunga mu bitosi. Genda oyigirize embizzi okwenaaba, olabe engeri gy'onoofuna obuwanguzi obutono ennyo. Kyandibadde nkulaakulana nnungi ennyo mu buyonjo singa embizzi zandibadde nnyonjo. Ziyigirize okwenaaba n'okwelongoosa nga akkapa bwe kabadde kakola! Mulimu gwa bwereere. Oyinza okunaaza embizzi eyo lwa maanyi, naye eyanguwa okudda mu bitosi, era mangu ago n'eba mbi nga bwe yali edda. Engeri yokka gy'oyinza okufunamu embizzi okwenaaba kwe kugifuula akkapa; olwo eneenaaba n'eba nnyonjo, naye si nga ekyo tekinnabaawo! Ka tugambe nti enkyukakyuka eyo etuukiridde, olwo ekyo ekyali ekizibu oba ekitasoboka kifuuka kyangu; embizzi okuva olwo eneesaanira ekisenge kyo eky'okusembeza n'ekiwempe kyo eky'oku kyoto. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n'omuntu atatya Katonda; toyinza kumuwaliriza kukola ekyo omuntu eyazzibwa obuggya ky'akola n'okwagala okungi; oyinza okumuyigiriza, n'omulaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi, naye tayinza kuyiga mukwatirwa gw'obutukuvu, kubanga taguteekamu mwoyo; obuzaaliranwa bwe bumutwala ekkubo eddala. Mukama bw'amufuula omuntu omuggya, olwo ebintu byonna bifuna endabika endala. Enkyukakyuka eno nnene nnyo, olwo emu emirundi nawulira omuntu eyakyusa eddiini ng'agamba, “Oba ensi yonna ekyusiddwa, oba nze.” Obuzaaliranwa obuggya bugoberera obutuukirivu mu ngeri ey'obutonde nga obuzaaliranwa obukadde bwe bwabula nga bunoonya ekibi. Nga mukisa okufuna obuzaaliranwa obwenkana awo! Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka y'ayinza okubuwa.

Wali okitegedde nga kya kitalo kitya eri Mukama okuwa omuntu omutima omuggya n'omwoyo omulungi? Oboolyawo olabyeko ekkovu, eryalwana n'ekkovu eddala, ne lifiirwa olumu ku njala zaalyo, ne kumeruka olwejjala oluggya. Ekyo kya kwewuunya; naye kya kwewuunya nnyo okusinga nti omuntu aweebwa omutima omuggya. Kino, mazima ddala, kyamagero ekisukka amaanyi g'obutonde. Waliwo omuti. Bw'otema ettabi limu ku gwo, eddala liyinza okumeruka mu kifo kyalyo; naye oyinza okukyusa omuti; oyinza okuwoomya omubisi omukaatuufu; oyinza okuleetera eriggwa okubala ettiini? Oyinza okuluka mu gwo ekintu ekirungi era ekyo kye kifaananyi obutonde kye butuwa eky'omulimu gw'ekisa; naye okukyusa ddala omubisi gw'omuti ogw'obulamu kyandibadde kyamagero mazima. Ekyewuunyo n'ekyama eky'amaanyi ekifaanana bwe kityo Katonda ky'akolera bonna abakkiriza Yesu.

Bw'oweeyo eri omulimu gwe ogw'obwakatonda, Mukama alikyusa obuzaaliranwa bwo; aligonza obuzaaliranwa obukadde, era alikufuuwa obulamu obuggya. Teeka obwesige bwo mu Mukama Yesu Kristo, era aliggya omutima ogw'ejjinja mu mubiri gwo, era alikuwa omutima ogw'ennyama. Awaali buli kimu nga kikalubo, buli kimu kinaaba kigonvu; awaali buli kimu nga kibi, buli kimu kinaaba kirungi: awaali buli kimu nga kiserengeta, buli kimu kinaayambuka n'amaanyi amangi. Empologoma ey'obusungu erifulumya omwana gw'endiga ogw'obuwombeefu; namuŋŋoona ow'obucaafu aliddukira mu maaso g'enjiibwa ey'obulongoofu; omusota omubi ogw'obulimba gulirinnyirirwa wansi w'ekisinziiro ky'amazima.

Ndabye n'amaaso gange enkyukakyuka ez'ekitalo bwe zityo mu mpisa n'omwoyo, ne siggwaamu ssuubi ku muntu yenna. Nnandisobodde, singa kyandisaanidde, okulaga abo abaali abakazi abamalaaya kaakano nga balongoofu ng'omuzira ogugudde, n'abasajja abaali bavvoola Katonda kaakano abasanyusa bonna ababeetoolodde olw'okwewaayo kwabwe okungi. Ababbi bafuulibwa beesigwa, abatamiivu bawuluka, abalimba bafuuka ab'amazima, n'abanyoomi bafuuka abanyiikivu. Buli we ekisa kya Katonda kwe kirabikira omuntu, kimutendeka okwegaana obutatya Katonda n'okwegomba kw'ensi, n'okubeera obulamu obw'obwegendereza, obw'obutuukirivu, n'obw'okutya Katonda mu nsi eno embi eya kaakano: era, ggwe omusomi omwagalwa, kirikukolera ekintu kye kimu.

“Sisobola kukola nkyukakyuka eno,” bw'ayogera omu. Ani yagambye nti osobola? Ekyawandiikibwa kye tujuliza tekyogera ku ekyo omuntu ky'alikola, wabula ku ekyo Katonda ky'alikola. Kye kisuubizo kya Katonda, era kya kumutuukiriza yekka ebyo bye yeeyama. Mwesige atuukirize Ekigambo kye gy'oli, era kirikolebwa.

“Naye kirikolebwa kitya?” Ekyo kikukwatako kitya? Mukama alina okunnyonnyola engeri ze nga tonnamukkiriza? Omulimu gwa Mukama mu nsonga eno kyama kinene: Omwoyo Omutukuvu y'agukola. Oyo eyakola ekisuubizo y'alina obuvunaanyizibwa okukwata ku kisuubizo, era asaanira omulimu ogwo. Katonda, asuubiza enkyukakyuka eno ey'ekitalo, mazima ddala alikituukiriza mu bonna abakkiriza Yesu, kubanga bonna ng'abo abawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda. Singa okikkiriza! Singa okola Mukama ow'ekisa obwenkanya n'okukkiriza nti asobola era alikukolera kino, wadde nga kiriba kyamagero kinene! Singa okkiriza nti Katonda tayinza kulimba! Singa omwesiga olw'omutima omuggya, n'omwoyo omulungi, kubanga asobola okubikuwa! Mukama akuwe okukkiriza mu kisuubizo kye, okukkiriza mu Mwana we, okukkiriza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n'okukkiriza mu ye, era eri ye kubeere okutenderezebwa n'ekitiibwa n'obukulu emirembe n'emirembe! Amiina.

Katonda, atayinza kulimba, ayogedde mu Ezeekyeri 36:26: Era ndibawa omutima omuggya, era ndissa omwoyo omuggya munda yammwe: era ndiggya omutima ogw'ejjinja mu mubiri gwammwe, era ndibawa omutima ogw'ennyama. Olaba, kyonna kiri nti "Ndikola," era "Ndikola." "Ndiwa," era "Ndiggyawo." Eno y'engeri ey'obwakabaka eya Kabaka wa bakabaka, asobola okutuukiriza byonna by'ayagala. Tewali kigambo kye ekineegwa wansi. Mukama amanyi bulungi nti toyinza kukyusa mutima gwo ggwe, era toyinza kutukuza buzaaliranwa bwo; naye era amanyi nti ye asobola byombi. Asobola okuleetera Omuwesiya okukyusa olususu lwe, n'engo okukyusa amabala gaayo. Wuliriza kino, weewuunye: asobola okukutonda omulundi ogwokubiri; asobola okukuleetera okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Kino kyamagero eky'ekisa, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu y'alikikola. Kyandibadde kya kwewuunya nnyo singa omuntu yeyimiridde ku ntobo y'Amazzi Agagwa aga Niagara, n'ayogera ekigambo ekyandireese omugga Niagara okutandika okukulukuta nga gwambuka, ne gubuuka ku lwazi luli oluwanvu kwe gukulukutira kaakano n'amaanyi amangi ennyo. Tewali kirala wabula amaanyi ga Katonda agandisobodde okukola ekyamagero ekyo; naye ekyo kyandisinze okwenkanankana n'ekyandibaddewo singa olugendo lw'obuzaaliranwa bwo lukyusibwa ddala. Byonna bisoboka eri Katonda. Asobola okukyusa oludda okwegomba kwo n'okukulukuta kw'obulamu bwo, era mu kifo ky'okuserengeta okuva ku Katonda, asobola okuleetera omuntu wo yenna okwambuka nga yeeyongera okusemberera Katonda. Ekyo, mu mazima, kye Mukama kye yasuubiza okukolera bonna abali mu ndagaano; era tumanyi okuva mu Byawandiikibwa nti abakkiriza bonna bali mu ndagaano. Ka nsome ebigambo nate: Era ndissa omwoyo omuggya munda yammwe: era ndiggya omutima ogw'ejjinja mu mubiri gwammwe, era ndibawa omutima ogw'ennyama. (Ezeekyeri 11:19). Nga kino kisuubizo kya kitalo! Era kiri weewaawo era amiina mu Kristo Yesu ku kitiibwa kya Katonda okuyita mu ffe. Ka tukinyweze; tukikkirize nga kya mazima, era tukyefunire ffe. Olwo kirituukirizibwa mu ffe, era ku nnaku n'emyaka egigenda okujja, tulyimba ku nkyukakyuka eyo ey'ekitalo ekisa kya Katonda ekifuga bye kikoze mu ffe. Kigwanira nnyo okulowoozebwako nti Mukama bw'aggyawo omutima ogw'ejjinja, ekikolwa ekyo kikoleddwa; era bwe kimala okukolebwa, tewali maanyi gamanyiddwa agayinza okuggyawo omutima omuggya ogwo gw'awa, n'omwoyo omulungi ogwo gw'assa munda yaffe. "Eby'ekisa n'okuyita kwa Katonda tebiriimu kwejjusa"; kwe kugamba, awatali kwejjusa ku ludda lwe; taggyawo kye yali awadde. Muleke akuzze buggya nga bw'olizzibwa obuggya. Okwenenya kw'omuntu n'okwelongoosa kumala bwangu okukoma, kubanga embwa eddayo ku biseseme byayo; naye Katonda bw'assa omutima omuggya mu ffe, omutima omuggya guba wo emirembe gyonna, era teguddayo nate kukaluba ng'ejjinja. Oyo eyagufuula ennyama y'aligukuuma bw'atyo. Mu kino tuyinza okusanyuka n'okujaguza emirembe gyonna mu ekyo Katonda ky'atonda mu bwakabaka bw'ekisa kye. Okwogera ensonga eno mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo--wali owuliddeko ku kigero kya Mr. Rowland Hill eky'akkapa n'embizzi enkazi? Ndikyogera mu ngeri yange, okunnyonnyola ebigambo bya Mulokozi waffe eby'amaanyi--"Kibagwanira okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri." Olaba akkapa ako? Nga kitonde ekiyonjo! Nga bwe kanaaba obulungi n'olulimi lwako n'ebigere byako! Kya kulabako kya kitalo! Wali olabyeko embizzi enkazi ng'ekola bwe kityo? Nedda, tewali. Kiri okukontana n'obuzaaliranwa bwayo. Yeeyagalira okwevulunga mu bitosi. Genda oyigirize embizzi okwenaaba, olabe engeri gy'onoofuna obuwanguzi obutono ennyo. Kyandibadde nkulaakulana nnungi ennyo mu buyonjo singa embizzi zandibadde nnyonjo. Ziyigirize okwenaaba n'okwelongoosa nga akkapa bwe kabadde kakola! Mulimu gwa bwereere. Oyinza okunaaza embizzi eyo lwa maanyi, naye eyanguwa okudda mu bitosi, era mangu ago n'eba mbi nga bwe yali edda. Engeri yokka gy'oyinza okufunamu embizzi okwenaaba kwe kugifuula akkapa; olwo eneenaaba n'eba nnyonjo, naye si nga ekyo tekinnabaawo! Ka tugambe nti enkyukakyuka eyo etuukiridde, olwo ekyo ekyali ekizibu oba ekitasoboka kifuuka kyangu; embizzi okuva olwo eneesaanira ekisenge kyo eky'okusembeza n'ekiwempe kyo eky'oku kyoto. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n'omuntu atatya Katonda; toyinza kumuwaliriza kukola ekyo omuntu eyazzibwa obuggya ky'akola n'okwagala okungi; oyinza okumuyigiriza, n'omulaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi, naye tayinza kuyiga mukwatirwa gw'obutukuvu, kubanga taguteekamu mwoyo; obuzaaliranwa bwe bumutwala ekkubo eddala. Mukama bw'amufuula omuntu omuggya, olwo ebintu byonna bifuna endabika endala. Enkyukakyuka eno nnene nnyo, olwo emu emirundi nawulira omuntu eyakyusa eddiini ng'agamba, "Oba ensi yonna ekyusiddwa, oba nze." Obuzaaliranwa obuggya bugoberera obutuukirivu mu ngeri ey'obutonde nga obuzaaliranwa obukadde bwe bwabula nga bunoonya ekibi. Nga mukisa okufuna obuzaaliranwa obwenkana awo! Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka y'ayinza okubuwa. Wali okitegedde nga kya kitalo kitya eri Mukama okuwa omuntu omutima omuggya n'omwoyo omulungi? Oboolyawo olabyeko ekkovu, eryalwana n'ekkovu eddala, ne lifiirwa olumu ku njala zaalyo, ne kumeruka olwejjala oluggya. Ekyo kya kwewuunya; naye kya kwewuunya nnyo okusinga nti omuntu aweebwa omutima omuggya. Kino, mazima ddala, kyamagero ekisukka amaanyi g'obutonde. Waliwo omuti. Bw'otema ettabi limu ku gwo, eddala liyinza okumeruka mu kifo kyalyo; naye oyinza okukyusa omuti; oyinza okuwoomya omubisi omukaatuufu; oyinza okuleetera eriggwa okubala ettiini? Oyinza okuluka mu gwo ekintu ekirungi era ekyo kye kifaananyi obutonde kye butuwa eky'omulimu gw'ekisa; naye okukyusa ddala omubisi gw'omuti ogw'obulamu kyandibadde kyamagero mazima. Ekyewuunyo n'ekyama eky'amaanyi ekifaanana bwe kityo Katonda ky'akolera bonna abakkiriza Yesu. Bw'oweeyo eri omulimu gwe ogw'obwakatonda, Mukama alikyusa obuzaaliranwa bwo; aligonza obuzaaliranwa obukadde, era alikufuuwa obulamu obuggya. Teeka obwesige bwo mu Mukama Yesu Kristo, era aliggya omutima ogw'ejjinja mu mubiri gwo, era alikuwa omutima ogw'ennyama. Awaali buli kimu nga kikalubo, buli kimu kinaaba kigonvu; awaali buli kimu nga kibi, buli kimu kinaaba kirungi: awaali buli kimu nga kiserengeta, buli kimu kinaayambuka n'amaanyi amangi. Empologoma ey'obusungu erifulumya omwana gw'endiga ogw'obuwombeefu; namuŋŋoona ow'obucaafu aliddukira mu maaso g'enjiibwa ey'obulongoofu; omusota omubi ogw'obulimba gulirinnyirirwa wansi w'ekisinziiro ky'amazima. Ndabye n'amaaso gange enkyukakyuka ez'ekitalo bwe zityo mu mpisa n'omwoyo, ne siggwaamu ssuubi ku muntu yenna. Nnandisobodde, singa kyandisaanidde, okulaga abo abaali abakazi abamalaaya kaakano nga balongoofu ng'omuzira ogugudde, n'abasajja abaali bavvoola Katonda kaakano abasanyusa bonna ababeetoolodde olw'okwewaayo kwabwe okungi. Ababbi bafuulibwa beesigwa, abatamiivu bawuluka, abalimba bafuuka ab'amazima, n'abanyoomi bafuuka abanyiikivu. Buli we ekisa kya Katonda kwe kirabikira omuntu, kimutendeka okwegaana obutatya Katonda n'okwegomba kw'ensi, n'okubeera obulamu obw'obwegendereza, obw'obutuukirivu, n'obw'okutya Katonda mu nsi eno embi eya kaakano: era, ggwe omusomi omwagalwa, kirikukolera ekintu kye kimu. "Sisobola kukola nkyukakyuka eno," bw'ayogera omu. Ani yagambye nti osobola? Ekyawandiikibwa kye tujuliza tekyogera ku ekyo omuntu ky'alikola, wabula ku ekyo Katonda ky'alikola. Kye kisuubizo kya Katonda, era kya kumutuukiriza yekka ebyo bye yeeyama. Mwesige atuukirize Ekigambo kye gy'oli, era kirikolebwa. "Naye kirikolebwa kitya?" Ekyo kikukwatako kitya? Mukama alina okunnyonnyola engeri ze nga tonnamukkiriza? Omulimu gwa Mukama mu nsonga eno kyama kinene: Omwoyo Omutukuvu y'agukola. Oyo eyakola ekisuubizo y'alina obuvunaanyizibwa okukwata ku kisuubizo, era asaanira omulimu ogwo. Katonda, asuubiza enkyukakyuka eno ey'ekitalo, mazima ddala alikituukiriza mu bonna abakkiriza Yesu, kubanga bonna ng'abo abawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda. Singa okikkiriza! Singa okola Mukama ow'ekisa obwenkanya n'okukkiriza nti asobola era alikukolera kino, wadde nga kiriba kyamagero kinene! Singa okkiriza nti Katonda tayinza kulimba! Singa omwesiga olw'omutima omuggya, n'omwoyo omulungi, kubanga asobola okubikuwa! Mukama akuwe okukkiriza mu kisuubizo kye, okukkiriza mu Mwana we, okukkiriza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n'okukkiriza mu ye, era eri ye kubeere okutenderezebwa n'ekitiibwa n'obukulu emirembe n'emirembe! Amiina.

fields.title: Olw'Ekisa Okuyita mu Kukkiriza
fields.body_html:
OLW'EKISA OKUYITA MU KUKKIRIZA

“Kubanga olw'ekisa mwalokolebwa, okuyita mu kukkiriza” (Abaefeso 2:8).

Ndowooza nga kirungi okukyama katono ku bbali, ndyoke nsabe omusomi wange atunuulire n'okusinza ensulo eyennyini ey'obulokozi bwaffe, ye kisa kya Katonda. “Olw'ekisa mwalokolebwa.” Olw'okuba Katonda wa kisa, abantu aboonoonyi kyebava basonyiyibwa, bakyusibwa, batukuzibwa, ne balokolebwa. Si lwa kintu kyonna ekiri mu bo, oba ekiyinza okubaamu, kyebava balokolebwa; wabula lwa kwagala okutaliiko kkomo, obulungi, obusaasizi, okukwatibwa ekisa, okusaasira, n'ekisa kya Katonda. Kale linda akaseera katono ku nsulo. Tunuulira omugga omuyonjo ogw'amazzi ag'obulamu, nga guva ku ntebe ya Katonda n'ey'Omwana gw'Endiga!

Nga kya buziba ki ekisa kya Katonda! Ani ayinza okupima obugazi bwakyo? Ani ayinza okugera obuziba bwakyo? Nga bwe kiri n'engeri endala zonna eza Katonda, kirina obungi obutakoma. Katonda ajjudde okwagala, kubanga “Katonda kwe kwagala.” Katonda ajjudde obulungi; erinnya lyennyini “God” (Katonda) mu Lungereza livva ku kigambo “good” (omulungi). Obulungi n'okwagala ebitaliiko kkomo biri mu ssa eryennyini ery'Obwakatonda. Olw'okuba “okusaasira kwe kubeerera emirembe gyonna,” abantu kyebava batazikirizibwa; olw'okuba “okusaasira kwe tekuggwaawo,” aboonoonyi kyebava baleetebwa gy'ali ne basonyiyibwa.

Kijjukire kino; oleme okugwa mu kukyama ng'ossa omwoyo gwo ennyo ku kukkiriza, olukalu olw'obulokozi, n'oova okwerabira ekisa, ye nsulo era ye nsibuko y'okukkiriza kwennyini. Okukkiriza mulimu gwa kisa kya Katonda mu ffe. Tewali ayinza kwogera nti Yesu ye Kristo wabula ku bwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu. “Tewali ajja gye ndi,” bw'ayogera Yesu, “wabula Kitange eyantuma bw'amusika.” Bwe kityo okukkiriza, kwe kujja eri Kristo, kuva ku kusika kwa Katonda. Ekisa kye kisookerwako era kye kikomekkerezaako ensonga y'obulokozi; n'okukkiriza, ne bwe kuba kikulu, kitundu bukyekitundu eky'ebyuma ekisa bye gukozesa. Tulokolebwa “okuyita mu kukkiriza,” naye obulokozi buva “ku kisa.” Langirira ebigambo ebyo ng'oyita mu kkondeere lya malayika omukulu: “Olw'ekisa mwalokolebwa.” Amawulire amalungi ki gano eri abatasaanidde!

Okukkiriza kutwala ekifo eky'omukutu oba omudumu ogusenya amazzi. Ekisa ye nsulo era ye mugga; okukkiriza gwe mukutu omulukulukuto gw'okusaasira gwe guyita nga guserengeta okunnyweza abaana b'abantu abalumwa ennyonta. Kya nnaku nnyingi omukutu bwe gumenyeka. Kya nnaku okulaba okwetooloola Ruumi emikutu emingi egy'ekitiibwa egy'amazzi egitakyaleeta mazzi mu kibuga, kubanga entamiivu zaagyo zaamenyeka ne ebizimbe ebyo eby'ekitalo nga byayonooneka. Omukutu guteekwa okusigala nga tegumenyese okusobola okutwala amazzi; era mu ngeri y'emu, okukkiriza kuteekwa okuba okw'amazima era okunywevu, nga kutuuka butereevu eri Katonda ne kuserengeta butereevu gye tuli, kulyoke kufuuke omukutu omugasa ogw'okusaasira eri emyoyo gyaffe.

Kyokka, nkujjukiza nate nti okukkiriza gwe mukutu ogutwala amazzi gwokka, so si nsulo yennyini, era tetuteekwa kukutunuulira nnyo ne tukugulumiza okusinga ensibuko ya Katonda ey'omukisa gwonna, eri mu kisa kya Katonda. Tofuulanga kukkiriza kwo Kristo, so tokulowoozanga ng'ensibuko yeetongodde ey'obulokozi bwo. Obulamu bwaffe busangibwa mu “kutunuulira Yesu,” so si mu kutunuulira okukkiriza kwaffe ffe. Olw'okukkiriza ebintu byonna bituusibwa okutuukirira gye tuli; kyokka amaanyi tegali mu kukkiriza, wabula gali mu Katonda okukkiriza gwe kwesigama. Ekisa gwe yingini ow'amaanyi, n'okukkiriza gwe lujegere olusiba eggaali ly'omwoyo ku maanyi amanene agagitambuza. Obutuukirivu obw'okukkiriza si bulungi bwa mpisa obw'okukkiriza, wabula bwe butuukirivu bwa Yesu Kristo okukkiriza kwe kukwata ne kwefunira. Emirembe egiri mu mwoyo tegiva mu kulowooza ku kukkiriza kwaffe ffe; wabula gitujjira nga giva mu oyo ye mirembe gyaffe, oyo okukkiriza kwe kukwata ku lukugiro lw'ekyambalo kye, n'amaanyi ne gava mu ye ne gayingira mu mwoyo.

Laba nno, munnange omwagalwa, nti obunafu bw'okukkiriza kwo tebugenda kukuzikiriza. Omukono ogukankana guyinza okuweebwa ekirabo ekya zzaabu. Obulokozi bwa Mukama buyinza okutujjira newankubadde nga tulina okukkiriza ng'akaweke ka kaladaali kokka. Amaanyi gali mu kisa kya Katonda, so si mu kukkiriza kwaffe. Obubaka obukulu buyinza okuweerezebwa nga buyita mu waya ennuubi, era obujulizi bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu obuleeta emirembe buyinza okutuuka ku mutima nga buyita mu kukkiriza okuli ng'ewuzi ennuubi eyeeyanika ng'okumpi tesobola na kweggwanika obuzito bwayo. Lowooza ku oyo gw'otunuulira okusinga engeri gy'omutunuuliramu. Oteekwa okuggya amaaso go ne ku kutunuula kwo kwennyini, oleme kulaba kintu kirala okuggyako Yesu, n'ekisa kya Katonda ekyolesebwa mu ye.

Oteekwa okuggya amaaso go ne ku kutunuula kwo kwennyini, oleme kulaba kintu kirala okuggyako Yesu, n'ekisa kya Katonda ekyolesebwa mu ye.

fields.title: Okukkiriza, Kye Ki?
fields.body_html:
OKUKKIRIZA, KYE KI?

OKUKKIRIZA KUNO kye ki, okwo okugambibwako nti, “Olw'ekisa mwalokolebwa olw'okukkiriza?” Waliwo ennyinnyonnyola nnyingi ez'okukkiriza; naye kumpi zonna ennyinnyonnyola ze nsanze zinnetissizza obutategeera okusinga bwe nnali ntegedde nga sinnaziraba. Omuddugavu bwe yasoma essuula, yagamba nti “anaagitabula”; era kirabika bwe kityo bwe yakola, wadde nga yali ayagala okugivvuunula. Tuyinza okunnyonnyola okukkiriza okutuusa nga tewali muntu akitegeera. Nsuubira nga sijja kuzza musango ogwo. Okukkiriza kwe kimu ku bintu ebisinga obwangu, era oboolyawo olw'obwangu bwakwo kwe kusinga okuzibu okunnyonnyola.

Okukkiriza kye ki? Kukolebwa mu bintu bisatu—okumanya, okukkiririza, n'okwesiga. Okumanya kwe kusooka. “Kale banaakkiriza batya oyo gwe batawuliddeko?” Njagala okutegeezebwa ekintu nga sinnaba kukkiriza. “Okukkiriza kuva mu kuwulira”; kitugwanira okusooka okuwulira, tulyoke tumanye kye tuteekwa okukkiriza. “N'abo abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiga.” Ekigero eky'okumanya kyetaagisa mu kukkiriza; noolwekyo obukulu bw'okufuna okumanya. “Tega okutu kwo, ojje gye ndi; wulira, n'emmeeme yo eneeba nnamu.” Ekyo kye kyali ekigambo eky'omuprofeeti ow'edda, era kikyali kigambo kya njiri ne kaakano. Noonya mu Byawandiikibwa oyige Omwoyo Omutukuvu by'ayigiriza ku Kristo n'obulokozi bwe. Noonya okumanya Katonda: “Kubanga oyo ajja eri Katonda kimugwanira okukkiriza nti gy'ali, era nti awa empeera abo abamunoonya n'obunyiikivu.” Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuwe omwoyo ogw'okumanya n'ogw'okutya Mukama! Manya enjiri: manya amawulire amalungi kye gali, engeri gye googerera ku kusonyiyibwa okwa buwa, n'okukyuka kw'omutima, n'okusembezebwa mu maka ga Katonda, n'emikisa emirala egitabalika. Manya naddala Kristo Yesu Omwana wa Katonda, Omulokozi w'abantu, eyeegatta naffe olw'obuntu bwe, ate ng'ali omu ne Katonda; bw'atyo asobola okuba Omutabaganya wakati wa Katonda n'omuntu, asobola okuteeka omukono gwe ku bombi, n'okuba akakwate akayunga wakati w'omwonoonyi n'Omulamuzi w'ensi yonna. Fuba okugenda oyongera okumanya Kristo Yesu. Fuba naddala okumanya enjigiriza ey'ekiweebwayo kya Kristo; kubanga ekintu okukkiriza okulokola kwe kunywerera ennyo kye kino—“Katonda yali mu Kristo ng'atabaganya ensi n'yeye, nga tababalira bibi byabwe.” Manya nga Yesu “yafuuka ekikolimo ku lwaffe, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, Akolimiddwa buli muntu awanikibwa ku muti.” Nywa okuva ewala mu njigiriza ey'omulimu gwa Kristo ogw'okutuddira mu kifo; kubanga omwo mwe muli okukubagizibwa okusinga obuwoomi eri abaana b'abantu abazza omusango, kubanga Mukama “yamufuula ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufuuke obutuukirivu bwa Katonda mu ye.” Okukkiriza kutandika n'okumanya.

Omutima gugenda mu maaso okukkiriza nti ebintu bino bya mazima. Emmeeme ekkiririza nti Katonda gy'ali, era nti awulira okukaaba kw'emitima egy'amazima; nti enjiri eva eri Katonda; nti okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza ge mazima amakulu Katonda g'abikkulidde mu nnaku zino ez'oluvannyuma ng'ayita mu Mwoyo we mu ngeri eyeeyoleka okusinga edda. Awo omutima gukkiririza nti Yesu mazima ddala ye Katonda waffe era Omulokozi waffe, Omununuzi w'abantu, Nnabbi, Kabona, era Kabaka w'abantu be. Bino byonna bikkirizibwa ng'amazima ageesigika, agatateekwa kubuusibwabuusibwa. Nsaba nti oyinze okutuuka ku kino mangu ago. Nywerera okukkiriza nti “omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omwagalwa, gututukuza okuva mu kibi kyonna”; nti ekiweebwayo kye kituukiridde era Katonda akikkirizza ddala ku lw'omuntu, bw'atyo akkiriza Yesu tasalirwa musango. Kkiririza amazima gano nga bw'okkiririza ebigambo ebirala byonna; kubanga enjawulo eri wakati w'okukkiriza okwa bulijjo n'okukkiriza okulokola esinga kuba mu bintu okukkiriza kwe kukolebwako. Kkiriza obujulirwa bwa Katonda nga bw'okkiriza obujulirwa bwa kitaawo oba mukwano gwo. “Bwe tukkiriza obujulirwa bw'abantu, obujulirwa bwa Katonda businga.”

Okutuusa kaakano weeyongedde mu maaso okumpi n'okukkiriza; wabulako ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagisa okukujjuza, kwe kwesiga. Weewaayo eri Katonda ow'ekisa; wummuliza essuubi lyo ku njiri ey'ekisa; wesigamize emmeeme yo ku Mulokozi eyafa era omulamu; naaza ebibi byo mu musaayi ogutangirira; kkiriza obutuukirivu bwe obutuukiridde, na buli kintu kiba kirungi. Okwesiga kwe musaayi ogw'obulamu obw'okukkiriza; tewali kukkiriza kulokola awatali kwo. Aba Puritan baayolesanga okukkiriza n'ekigambo “recumbency.” Kyategeezanga okwesigama ku kintu. Weesigame n'obuzito bwo bwonna ku Kristo. Kyandibadde kyokulabirako ekirungi okusinga singa ngambye nti, gwa wansi obuwanvu bwo bwonna, ogalamire ku Lwazi olw'Emirembe Gyonna. Weesuule ku Yesu; wummulire mu ye; weewaayo gy'ali. Ekyo bwe kimala okukolebwa, oba okoze okukkiriza okulokola. Okukkiriza si kya buzibe; kubanga okukkiriza kutandika n'okumanya. Si kya kulowoozaako bwereere; kubanga okukkiriza kukkiririza ebintu bye kimatidde. Si kya butakolwa, kya kirooto; kubanga okukkiriza kwesiga, ne kuteeka ekiro kyakwo ku mazima ag'okubikkulirwa. Eyo y'engeri emu ey'okunnyonnyola okukkiriza kye kiri.

Ka ngezeeko nate. Okukkiriza kwe kukkiririza nti Kristo ye kyagambibwa okuba, era nti alikola ky'asuubizza okukola, n'oluvannyuma okukisuubira okuva gy'ali. Ebyawandiikibwa byogera ku Yesu Kristo nga bw'ali Katonda, Katonda mu mubiri gw'omuntu; nga bw'ali omutuukirivu mu mpisa ze; nga eyafuulibwa ekiweebwayo olw'ekibi ku lwaffe; nga eyeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe ku muti. Ebyawandiikibwa byogera ku ye nga eyamaliriza obujeemu, n'akomya ekibi, n'aleeta obutuukirivu obutaggwaawo. Ebiwandiiko ebitukuvu byeyongera okututegeeza nti “yazuukira mu bafu,” nti “abeera omulamu ennaku zonna okutwegayiririra,” nti yalinnya mu kitiibwa, era yatwala eggulu ku lw'abantu be, era nti anaatera okukomawo “okulamula ensi mu butuukirivu, n'abantu be mu bwenkanya.” Kitugwanira okukkiriza n'obunywevu bungi nti bwe kiri bwe kityo; kubanga buno bwe bujulirwa bwa Katonda Kitaffe bwe yagamba nti, “Ono ye Mwana wange omwagalwa; mumuwulirize.” Kino era kijulirwa Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu; kubanga Omwoyo ajulizza ku Kristo, mu Kigambo ekyaluŋŋamizibwa n'olw'ebyamagero eby'engeri nnyingi, n'olw'okukola kwe mu mitima gy'abantu. Kitugwanira okukkiriza obujulirwa buno nti bwa mazima.

Okukkiriza era kukkiririza nti Kristo alikola ky'asuubizza; nti okuva bwe yasuubiza obutagoba n'omu ku abo abajja gy'ali, kikakafu nti tajja kutugoba bwe tunaajja gy'ali. Okukkiriza kukkiririza nti okuva Yesu bwe yagamba nti, “Amazzi ge ndimuwa galifuuka mu ye oluzzi lw'amazzi agatiiriika okutuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo,” kiteekwa okuba nga kya mazima; era bwe tufuna Amazzi gano amalamu okuva eri Kristo galibeera mu ffe, era galitiiriika munda mu ffe ng'emigga egy'obulamu obutukuvu. Buli Kristo ky'asuubizza okukola alikikola, era kitugwanira okukkiriza kino, tulyoke tusuubire okusonyiyibwa, okuweebwa obutuukirivu, okukuumibwa, n'ekitiibwa eky'emirembe n'emirembe okuva mu mikono gye, nga bw'abisuubiza abamukkiriza.

Awo we wajja omutendera ogw'okuddirira ogwetaagisa. Yesu ye kyagambibwa okuba, Yesu alikola ky'agamba nti alikola; noolwekyo kitugwanira buli omu ku ffe okumwesiga, nga tugamba nti, “Anaaba gye ndi nga bw'agamba nti bw'ali, era anaankola nga bw'asuubizza okukola; neeteeka mu mikono gy'oyo eyalondebwa okulokola, alyoke andokole. Nywerera ku kisuubizo kye nti alikola nga bw'ayogedde.” Kuno kwe kukkiriza okulokola, era oyo akulina alina obulamu obutaggwaawo. Ne bw'aba n'akabi n'ebizibu bye byonna, ne bw'aba n'ekizikiza n'obunyiikaavu bwe byonna, ne bw'aba n'obunafu bwe n'ebibi bye byonna, oyo akkiriza bw'atyo mu Kristo Yesu tasalirwa musango, era talituuka mu kusalirwa musango emirembe gyonna.

Ennyinnyonnyola eyo ebeere ya mugaso! Nsuubira nga eneekozesebwa Omwoyo wa Katonda okuluŋŋamya omusomi wange mu mirembe egy'amangu ago. “Totya; kkiriza kyokka.” Wesige, obeere mu kuwummula.

Entiisa yange eri nti omusomi ayinza okumatira ku kutegeera ekiteekwa okukolebwa, ate n'atakikola. Okukkiriza okw'amazima okusinga obwavu okukola ddala kusinga okukkiriza okulowoozebwa okusinga obulungi naye okulekeddwa mu kifo eky'okuteebereza obwereere. Ekintu ekikulu kwe kukkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu mangu ago. Toweera bwongo ku njawulo n'ennyinnyonnyola. Omuntu alumwa enjala alya wadde nga tategeera ekyo emmere kye ekolebwamu, oba enteekateeka y'akamwa ke, oba engeri gy'egaayibwamu: aba mulamu kubanga alya. Omulala ow'amagezi amangi nnyo ategeera bulungi ennyo essayansi ey'okuliisibwa; naye bw'atalya alifa, wamu n'okumanya kwe kwonna. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti waliwo bangi mu kiseera kino mu Ggeyeena abaategeera enjigiriza ey'okukkiriza, naye ne batakkiriza. Ku luuyi olulala, tewali n'omu eyeesiga Mukama waffe Yesu eyali agobeddwa, wadde nga oboolyawo yali tasobola na luusi okunnyonnyola okukkiriza kwe mu magezi. Ayi omusomi omwagalwa, kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu ayingire mu mmeeme yo, naawe olibeera omulamu emirembe gyonna! “Akkiriza mu ye alina obulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Ku luuyi olulala, tewali n'omu eyeesiga Mukama waffe Yesu eyali agobeddwa, wadde nga oboolyawo yali tasobola na luusi okunnyonnyola okukkiriza kwe mu magezi. Ayi omusomi omwagalwa, kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu ayingire mu mmeeme yo, naawe olibeera omulamu emirembe gyonna! "Akkiriza mu ye alina obulamu obutaggwaawo."

fields.title: Okukkiriza Kuyinza Kutya Okugeraganyizibwa?
fields.body_html:
OKUKKIRIZA KUYINZA KUTYA OKUGERAGANYIZIBWA?

OKUSOBOZA ENSONGA ey'okukkiriza okweyongera okutegeerekeka, nja kukuwa ebifaananyi ebitonotono. Newankubadde nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka y'asobola okuzibula amaaso g'omusomi wange, kye kya buvunaanyizibwa bwange era n'essanyu lyange okuwaayo ekitangaala kyonna kye nsobola, n'okusaba Mukama ow'ekitiibwa azibule amaaso amaziba. Woowe, singa omusomi wange yeesabira okusaba kwe kumu ku lulwe!

Okukkiriza okulokola kulina ebikufaananako mu mubiri gw'omuntu.
Liriso eritunula. Olw'eriso tuleeta mu birowoozo ekyo ekiri ewala; tuyinza okuleeta enjuba n'emmunyeenye eziri ewala mu birowoozo olw'okutunula okumu okw'eriso. Bwe kutyo olw'okwesiga tuleeta Mukama waffe Yesu kumpi naffe; era newankubadde ng'ali ewala mu ggulu, ayingira mu mutima gwaffe. Tunuulira Yesu yekka; kubanga oluyimba lwa mazima ddala--
Waliwo obulamu mu kutunuulira Oyo eyakomererwa,
Waliwo obulamu kaakati wano ku lulwo.

Okukkiriza mukono ogukwata. Omukono gwaffe bwe gukwata ekintu kyonna ku lulwago, gukola kanaka ekyo okukkiriza kye kukola bwe kwenyweza Kristo n'emikisa egy'okununulibwa kwe. Okukkiriza kugamba nti, “Yesu wange.” Okukkiriza kuwulira ku musaayi ogusonyiwa, ne kuleekaana nti, “Nkikkiriza kinsonyiwe.” Okukkiriza kuyita ebyobusika bya Yesu afa nga byakwo; era byakwo ddala, kubanga okukkiriza gwe musika wa Kristo; yeewaayo yekka n'ebintu bye byonna eri okukkiriza. Twala, ggwe munnange, ekyo ekisa kye kikuteekeddeteekedde. Toobe mubbi, kubanga olina olukusa olwa Katonda: “Buli ayagala, addire amazzi ag'obulamu obwereere.” Oyo ayinza okuba n'eky'obugagga olw'okukikwata kyokka anaaba musiru ddala bw'anaasigala nga mwavu.

Okukkiriza mumwa oguliira ku Kristo. Emmere nga tennatuliisa, esaanidde okusooka okutuyingira. Kino kintu kyangu--okulya n'okunywa. Tukkiriza mu mumwa ekyo ekiri emmere yaffe, ne tulyoka tukkiriza kiserengete mu bitundu byaffe eby'omunda, gye kitwalibwa ne kigattibwa mu mubiri gwaffe. Pawulo agamba, mu bbaluwa ye eri Abaruumi, mu ssuula ey'ekkumi, “Ekigambo kiri kumpi naawe, mu kamwa ko.” Kale nno, ekisaanidde okukolebwa kwe kukumira, okukiganya kiserengete mu mwoyo. Woowe, singa abantu baba n'omululu! Kubanga oyo alumwa enjala n'alaba ennyama mu maaso ge tayeetaaga kuyigirizibwa ngeri ya kulya. “Mpa,” omu bwe yagamba, “akambe n'ekiwujjo n'akakisa.” Yali yeeteeseteese bulungi okukola ekisigadde. Mazima ddala, omutima ogulumwa enjala n'ennyonta ya Kristo gulina kumanya kyokka nti aweebwa ku bwereere, era amangwago gujja kumusembeza. Omusomi wange bw'aba mu mbeera ng'eyo, aleme kubuusabuusa kusembeza Yesu; kubanga ayinza okukakasa nti talivumirirwa olw'okukikola: kubanga eri “abo bonna abaamusembeza, yabawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda.” Tagoba n'omu, naye awa buli ajja obuyinza okusigala mwana emirembe gyonna.

Emirimu gy'obulamu gigeraganya okukkiriza mu ngeri nnyingi. Omulimi aziika ensigo ennungi mu ttaka, era asuubira si kubeera bulamu kyokka wabula n'okwaza. Alina okukkiriza mu ndagaano nti “okusiga n'amakungula tebiriggwaawo,” era asasulwa olw'okukkiriza kwe.

Omusuubuzi ateeka ssente ze mu bujjukirivu bw'omukuumi wa bbanka, era yeesiga ddala obwesigwa n'obunywevu bwa bbanka. Akwasa omuntu omulala ensimbi ze ez'entandikwa, era awulira emirembe okusinga singa yali ne zaabu enkalu ng'esibiddwa mu sanduuko ey'ekyuma.

Omulunnyanja yeesiga ennyanja. Bw'awuga aggya ekigere ku ntobo n'awummulira ku nnyanja emuwanirira. Teyandisobodde kuwuga singa teyeewaddeyo mubiri gwe gwonna eri amazzi.

Omuweesi wa zaabu ateeka ekyuma eky'omuwendo mu muliro ogulabika ng'ogwagala okukyokya, naye akizzaayo okuva mu kikoomi nga kirongooseddwa olw'ebbugumu.

Toyinza kukyuka wonna mu bulamu nga tolaba kukkiriza nga kukola wakati w'omuntu n'omuntu munne, oba wakati w'omuntu n'etteeka ery'obutonde. Kale nno, nga bwe twesiga mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku, bwe tutyo bwe tusaanidde okwesiga Katonda nga bw'abikkulirwa mu Kristo Yesu.

Okukkiriza kubaawo mu bantu ab'enjawulo mu bugazi obw'enjawulo, ng'okumanya kwabwe oba okukula kwabwe mu kisa bwe kuli. Oluusi okukkiriza kuba kwa kwenyweza ku Kristo kwokka; okuwulira nti weesigamye n'okwagala okwesigama bwe kutyo. Bw'oba oli ku lubalama lw'ennyanja ojja kulaba enkovu nga zeenywezezza ku lwazi. Otambula mpola mpola okutuuka ku lwazi; okuba ekiwuka ekyo ekkubo mangu n'omuggo gwo ne kigwa. Gezaako enkovu endala mu ngeri eyo. Omuwadde okulabula; yawulira okukuba kw'okubye munne, era yeenyweza n'amaanyi ge gonna. Toolimuggyako n'akatono; nedda ggwe! Kuba, era kuba nate, naye osobola okwasa olwazi mu bwangu okusinga. Munnaffe omutono, enkovu, tamanyi bingi, naye yeenyweza. Tamanyi butonde bwa lwazi mu by'ettaka, naye yeenyweza. Asobola okwenyweza, era afunye ekintu mw'anywerera: kuno kwe kumanya kwe kwonna, era akukozesa olw'obukuumi bwe n'obulokozi bwe. Bwe bulamu bw'enkovu okwenyweza ku lwazi, era bwe bulamu bw'omwonoonyi okwenyweza ku Yesu. Enkumi n'enkumi z'abantu ba Katonda tebalina kukkiriza kusinga kuno; bamanyi kimala okwenyweza ku Yesu n'omutima gwabwe gwonna n'emmeeme yaabwe, era kino kimala olw'emirembe egya kaakati n'obukuumi obutaggwaawo. Yesu Kristo gy'abo Mulokozi wa maanyi era ow'amaanyi, Olwazi olutasejjuka era olutakyukakyuka; beenyweza ku ye olw'obulamu obw'omuwendo, era okwenyweza kuno kubalokola. Ggwe omusomi, toyinza kwenyweza? Kikole kaakati kennyini.

Okukkiriza kulabika ng'omuntu omu yeesiga munne olw'okumanya obusukkulumu bwa munne. Kuno kukkiriza kwa waggulu; okukkiriza okumanyi ensonga lwaki kwesigama, era ne kukola ku ngeri eyo. Sirowooza nti enkovu emanyi bingi ku lwazi: naye okukkiriza nga bwe kukula kweeyongera okuba okw'amagezi. Omuzibe w'amaaso yeesiga omukulembeze we kubanga amanyi nti munne asobola okulaba, era ng'yeesiga, atambula munne w'amukulembera. Omwavu bw'azaalibwa nga muzibe w'amaaso tamanyi kulaba kye kiri; naye amanyi nti waliwo ekintu ng'okulaba, era nti munne akirina era kyava ateeka omukono gwe mu mukono gw'oyo alaba awatali kubuusabuusa, n'agoberera obukulembeze bwe. “Tutambulira mu kukkiriza, so si mu kulaba.” “Balina omukisa abo abatalaba, ate ne bakkiriza.” Kino kifaananyi kirungi nnyo eky'okukkiriza; tumanyi nti Yesu alina obusaanidde, n'amaanyi, n'omukisa, bye tutalina, era kyetuva twesiga ye n'essanyu abeere gye tuli ekyo kye tutasobola kwebeerera ffe fennyini. Twesiga ye ng'omuzibe w'amaaso bw'eesiga omukulembeze we. Tasaasaanya bwesige bwaffe; naye ye “yafuulibwa Katonda amagezi gye tuli, n'obutuukirivu, n'okutukuzibwa, n'okununulibwa.”

Buli mulenzi agenda ku ssomero ateekwa okukozesa okukkiriza ng'ayiga. Omusomesa we amuyigiriza jogirafiya, era amuyigiriza engeri ensi gy'efaanana, n'okubaawo kw'ebibuga ebinene n'obwakabaka. Omulenzi ye kennyini tamanyi nti ebintu bino bya mazima, wabula nga akkiriza omusomesa we, n'ebitabo ebiteekeddwa mu ngalo ze. Ekyo kye kw'olina okukola ne Kristo, bw'oba onooolokolebwa; olina okumanya kubanga y'akubuulira, okkirize kubanga akukakasa nti bwe kiri bwe kityo, era weesige ye kubanga akusuubiza nti obulokozi bwe buliva mu ekyo. Kumpi byonna gwe nange bye tumanyi bituujjidde olw'okukkiriza. Waliwo ekintu ekyavumbulwa mu ssaayansi, era tukikakasa. Ku nsonga ki kwe tukikkiririza? Ku buyinza bw'abasajja abamu abamanyiddwa ab'okuyiga, abalina erinnya eryanywezebwa. Tetwakola oba okulaba okugezesa kwabwe, naye tukkiriza obujulizi bwabwe. Olina okukola bwe kityo ku bikwata ku Yesu: kubanga akuyigiriza amazima agamu oteekwa okuba omuyigirizwa we, era okkirize ebigambo bye; kubanga yakola ebikolwa ebimu oteekwa okuba omukiriza we, era weesige ye. Asukkuluma nnyo okukusinga, era yeewaayo eri obwesige bwo nga Ssebo wo era Mukama wo. Bw'onoomusembeza ye n'ebigambo bye onoolokolebwa.

Engeri endala era ey'ekitiibwa ekisingako ey'okukkiriza y'okukkiriza okuva mu kwagala. Lwaki omulenzi yeesiga kitaawe? Ensonga lwaki omwana yeesiga kitaawe kubanga amwagala. Balina omukisa era basanyufu abo abalina okukkiriza okuwoomu mu Yesu, okulukibwa wamu n'okwagala okungi eri ye, kubanga buno bwesige bwa kuwummula. Abaagalana ba Yesu bano basanyusibwa empisa ye, era basanyukira omulimu gwe, batwalibwa ekisa eky'okwagala kye yalaga, era kyebava batasobola kulekera awo kumwesiga, kubanga bamwagala nnyo, bamussaamu ekitiibwa, era bamwagala.

Engeri ey'okwesiga Omulokozi mu kwagala eyinza okugeraganyizibwa bwe kityo. Omukyala oyo mukazi wa musawo asinga okumanyika mu kiseera kino. Akwatibwa endwadde ey'akabi, era agwanguzibwa amaanyi gaayo; kyokka ateefu era muteefu mu ngeri ey'ekitalo, kubanga bba yafuula endwadde eno okuyiga kwe okw'enjawulo, era awonyezza enkumi n'enkumi abaali balumizibwa mu ngeri y'emu. Teyeeraliikirira n'akatono, kubanga awulira ng'ali mirembe ddala mu mikono gy'oyo gw'ayagala ennyo, era omwo obukugu n'okwagala mwe bitabuliddwa mu ngeri yaabyo esingira ddala. Okukkiriza kwe kwa magezi era kwa butonde; bba, mu ngeri zonna, akusaanira. Luno lwe lubu lw'okukkiriza abakkiriza abasinga essanyu kwe bakozesa eri Kristo. Tewali musawo ng'oyo, tewali asobola kulokola nga ye; tumwagala, era n'atwagala, era kyetuva twewaayo mu mikono gye, ne tukkiriza kyonna ky'alagira, ne tukola kyonna ky'atulagira. Tuwulira nti tewali kintu kiyinza kulagirwa bubi ng'ali mukulu w'ensonga zaffe; kubanga atwagala nnyo nnyo tasobola kutuleka kuzikirira, oba okubonaabona obulumi obumu obutaliiko nsonga.

Okukkiriza gwe musingi gw'obuwulize, era kino kiyinza okulabika bulungi mu bintu by'obulamu. Kapiteeni bw'eesiga omugoba okuvuga ekyombo kye okutuuka ku mwalo, aduumira ekyombo ng'ebiragiro bye bwe biri. Omutambuze bw'eesiga omukulembeze okumuyisa mu kkubo eritagenderayo, agoberera ekkubo omukulembeze we ly'alaga. Omulwadde bw'akkiriza omusawo, agoberera n'obwegendereza eddagala lye n'ebiragiro bye. Okukkiriza okugaana okugondera ebiragiro by'Omulokozi kwa bunnanfusi bwereere, era tekulilokola mwoyo. Twesiga Yesu okutulokola; atuwa ebiragiro ku kkubo ery'obulokozi; tugoberera ebiragiro ebyo ne tulokolebwa. Omusomi wange aleme kwerabira kino. Kwesiga Yesu, era kakase okwesiga kwo ng'okola kyonna ky'akulagira.

Engeri ey'okukkiriza ey'amaanyi eva mu kumanya okukakafu; kuno kuva mu kukula mu kisa, era y'okukkiriza okukkiriza Kristo kubanga kumumanyi, era ne kumwesiga kubanga kwakakasa nti mwesigwa awatali kubuusabuusa. Omukkiriza omukadde yali ne mpisa y'okuwandiika “T” ne “P” ku mbiriizi za Bayibuli ye buli lwe yali agezesezza n'akakasa ekisuubizo. Nga kyangu okwesiga Omulokozi eyagezesebwa n'akakasibwa! Toyinza kukola kino kaakati, naye ojja kukikola. Buli kintu kiteekwa okuba n'entandikwa. Olisituka okutuuka ku kukkiriza okw'amaanyi mu kiseera kyakyo. Okukkiriza kuno okukuze tekusaba bubonero na bimanyiso, naye kukkiriza n'obuvumu. Tunuulira okukkiriza kw'omugoba omukugu ow'ekyombo--emirundi mingi kunnyisizza. Asumulula omuguwa gwe, avuga n'ava ku lukalu. Okumala ennaku, wiiki, oba n'emyezi, talaba ttanga wadde lubalama; kyokka agenda mu maaso emisana n'ekiro awatali kutya, okutuusa lumu ku makya bwe yeezuula ng'ali butereevu okwolekera omwalo gw'ayagadde gw'abadde ayolekera. Azudde atya ekkubo lye ku buziba obutaliiko kkubo? Yeesize kompasi ye, akalendaali ke ak'oku nnyanja, endabirwamu ye, n'ebintu eby'omu ggulu; era ng'agondera obukulembeze bwabyo, awatali kulaba lukalu, avuze bulungi ddala ne kitamwetaagisa kukyusa nsonda n'emu okuyingira omwalo. Kintu kya kitalo--okuvuga oba okuseeyeeya awatali kulaba. Mu by'omwoyo kintu kya mukisa okuva ddala ku lubalama olw'okulaba n'okuwulira, n'okugamba nti, “Weeraba” eri enneewulira ez'omunda, ebifa eby'essanyu, obubonero, ebimanyiso, n'ebirala. Kya kitiibwa okuba ewala ku nnyanja ey'okwagala okwa Katonda, ng'okkiririza mu Katonda, era ng'oyolekera eggulu butereevu ng'ogoberera obulagirizi bw'Ekigambo kya Katonda. “Balina omukisa abo abatalaba, ate ne bakkiriza”; abo baliweebwa okuyingira okugazi ku nkomerero, n'olugendo olutafudde ku kkubo. Omusomi wange tajja kwesiga Katonda mu Kristo Yesu? Awo we mpummulira n'obwesige obw'essanyu. Owooluganda, jangu naffe, era kkiriza Kitaffe n'Omulokozi waffe. Jangu kaakati kennyini.

Ggwe omusomi, toyinza kwenyweza? Kikole kaakati kennyini. Okukkiriza kulabika ng'omuntu omu yeesiga munne olw'okumanya obusukkulumu bwa munne. Kuno kukkiriza kwa waggulu; okukkiriza okumanyi ensonga lwaki kwesigama, era ne kukola ku ngeri eyo. Sirowooza nti enkovu emanyi bingi ku lwazi: naye okukkiriza nga bwe kukula kweeyongera okuba okw'amagezi. Omuzibe w'amaaso yeesiga omukulembeze we kubanga amanyi nti munne asobola okulaba, era ng'yeesiga, atambula munne w'amukulembera. Omwavu bw'azaalibwa nga muzibe w'amaaso tamanyi kulaba kye kiri; naye amanyi nti waliwo ekintu ng'okulaba, era nti munne akirina era kyava ateeka omukono gwe mu mukono gw'oyo alaba awatali kubuusabuusa, n'agoberera obukulembeze bwe. "Tutambulira mu kukkiriza, so si mu kulaba." "Balina omukisa abo abatalaba, ate ne bakkiriza." Kino kifaananyi kirungi nnyo eky'okukkiriza; tumanyi nti Yesu alina obusaanidde, n'amaanyi, n'omukisa, bye tutalina, era kyetuva twesiga ye n'essanyu abeere gye tuli ekyo kye tutasobola kwebeerera ffe fennyini. Twesiga ye ng'omuzibe w'amaaso bw'eesiga omukulembeze we. Tasaasaanya bwesige bwaffe; naye ye "yafuulibwa Katonda amagezi gye tuli, n'obutuukirivu, n'okutukuzibwa, n'okununulibwa." Buli mulenzi agenda ku ssomero ateekwa okukozesa okukkiriza ng'ayiga. Omusomesa we amuyigiriza jogirafiya, era amuyigiriza engeri ensi gy'efaanana, n'okubaawo kw'ebibuga ebinene n'obwakabaka. Omulenzi ye kennyini tamanyi nti ebintu bino bya mazima, wabula nga akkiriza omusomesa we, n'ebitabo ebiteekeddwa mu ngalo ze. Ekyo kye kw'olina okukola ne Kristo, bw'oba onooolokolebwa; olina okumanya kubanga y'akubuulira, okkirize kubanga akukakasa nti bwe kiri bwe kityo, era weesige ye kubanga akusuubiza nti obulokozi bwe buliva mu ekyo. Kumpi byonna gwe nange bye tumanyi bituujjidde olw'okukkiriza. Waliwo ekintu ekyavumbulwa mu ssaayansi, era tukikakasa. Ku nsonga ki kwe tukikkiririza? Ku buyinza bw'abasajja abamu abamanyiddwa ab'okuyiga, abalina erinnya eryanywezebwa. Tetwakola oba okulaba okugezesa kwabwe, naye tukkiriza obujulizi bwabwe. Olina okukola bwe kityo ku bikwata ku Yesu: kubanga akuyigiriza amazima agamu oteekwa okuba omuyigirizwa we, era okkirize ebigambo bye; kubanga yakola ebikolwa ebimu oteekwa okuba omukiriza we, era weesige ye. Asukkuluma nnyo okukusinga, era yeewaayo eri obwesige bwo nga Ssebo wo era Mukama wo. Bw'onoomusembeza ye n'ebigambo bye onoolokolebwa. Engeri endala era ey'ekitiibwa ekisingako ey'okukkiriza y'okukkiriza okuva mu kwagala. Lwaki omulenzi yeesiga kitaawe? Ensonga lwaki omwana yeesiga kitaawe kubanga amwagala. Balina omukisa era basanyufu abo abalina okukkiriza okuwoomu mu Yesu, okulukibwa wamu n'okwagala okungi eri ye, kubanga buno bwesige bwa kuwummula. Abaagalana ba Yesu bano basanyusibwa empisa ye, era basanyukira omulimu gwe, batwalibwa ekisa eky'okwagala kye yalaga, era kyebava batasobola kulekera awo kumwesiga, kubanga bamwagala nnyo, bamussaamu ekitiibwa, era bamwagala. Engeri ey'okwesiga Omulokozi mu kwagala eyinza okugeraganyizibwa bwe kityo. Omukyala oyo mukazi wa musawo asinga okumanyika mu kiseera kino. Akwatibwa endwadde ey'akabi, era agwanguzibwa amaanyi gaayo; kyokka ateefu era muteefu mu ngeri ey'ekitalo, kubanga bba yafuula endwadde eno okuyiga kwe okw'enjawulo, era awonyezza enkumi n'enkumi abaali balumizibwa mu ngeri y'emu. Teyeeraliikirira n'akatono, kubanga awulira ng'ali mirembe ddala mu mikono gy'oyo gw'ayagala ennyo, era omwo obukugu n'okwagala mwe bitabuliddwa mu ngeri yaabyo esingira ddala. Okukkiriza kwe kwa magezi era kwa butonde; bba, mu ngeri zonna, akusaanira. Luno lwe lubu lw'okukkiriza abakkiriza abasinga essanyu kwe bakozesa eri Kristo. Tewali musawo ng'oyo, tewali asobola kulokola nga ye; tumwagala, era n'atwagala, era kyetuva twewaayo mu mikono gye, ne tukkiriza kyonna ky'alagira, ne tukola kyonna ky'atulagira. Tuwulira nti tewali kintu kiyinza kulagirwa bubi ng'ali mukulu w'ensonga zaffe; kubanga atwagala nnyo nnyo tasobola kutuleka kuzikirira, oba okubonaabona obulumi obumu obutaliiko nsonga. Okukkiriza gwe musingi gw'obuwulize, era kino kiyinza okulabika bulungi mu bintu by'obulamu. Kapiteeni bw'eesiga omugoba okuvuga ekyombo kye okutuuka ku mwalo, aduumira ekyombo ng'ebiragiro bye bwe biri. Omutambuze bw'eesiga omukulembeze okumuyisa mu kkubo eritagenderayo, agoberera ekkubo omukulembeze we ly'alaga. Omulwadde bw'akkiriza omusawo, agoberera n'obwegendereza eddagala lye n'ebiragiro bye. Okukkiriza okugaana okugondera ebiragiro by'Omulokozi kwa bunnanfusi bwereere, era tekulilokola mwoyo. Twesiga Yesu okutulokola; atuwa ebiragiro ku kkubo ery'obulokozi; tugoberera ebiragiro ebyo ne tulokolebwa. Omusomi wange aleme kwerabira kino. Kwesiga Yesu, era kakase okwesiga kwo ng'okola kyonna ky'akulagira. Engeri ey'okukkiriza ey'amaanyi eva mu kumanya okukakafu; kuno kuva mu kukula mu kisa, era y'okukkiriza okukkiriza Kristo kubanga kumumanyi, era ne kumwesiga kubanga kwakakasa nti mwesigwa awatali kubuusabuusa. Omukkiriza omukadde yali ne mpisa y'okuwandiika "T" ne "P" ku mbiriizi za Bayibuli ye buli lwe yali agezesezza n'akakasa ekisuubizo. Nga kyangu okwesiga Omulokozi eyagezesebwa n'akakasibwa! Toyinza kukola kino kaakati, naye ojja kukikola. Buli kintu kiteekwa okuba n'entandikwa. Olisituka okutuuka ku kukkiriza okw'amaanyi mu kiseera kyakyo. Okukkiriza kuno okukuze tekusaba bubonero na bimanyiso, naye kukkiriza n'obuvumu. Tunuulira okukkiriza kw'omugoba omukugu ow'ekyombo--emirundi mingi kunnyisizza. Asumulula omuguwa gwe, avuga n'ava ku lukalu. Okumala ennaku, wiiki, oba n'emyezi, talaba ttanga wadde lubalama; kyokka agenda mu maaso emisana n'ekiro awatali kutya, okutuusa lumu ku makya bwe yeezuula ng'ali butereevu okwolekera omwalo gw'ayagadde gw'abadde ayolekera. Azudde atya ekkubo lye ku buziba obutaliiko kkubo? Yeesize kompasi ye, akalendaali ke ak'oku nnyanja, endabirwamu ye, n'ebintu eby'omu ggulu; era ng'agondera obukulembeze bwabyo, awatali kulaba lukalu, avuze bulungi ddala ne kitamwetaagisa kukyusa nsonda n'emu okuyingira omwalo. Kintu kya kitalo--okuvuga oba okuseeyeeya awatali kulaba. Mu by'omwoyo kintu kya mukisa okuva ddala ku lubalama olw'okulaba n'okuwulira, n'okugamba nti, "Weeraba" eri enneewulira ez'omunda, ebifa eby'essanyu, obubonero, ebimanyiso, n'ebirala. Kya kitiibwa okuba ewala ku nnyanja ey'okwagala okwa Katonda, ng'okkiririza mu Katonda, era ng'oyolekera eggulu butereevu ng'ogoberera obulagirizi bw'Ekigambo kya Katonda. "Balina omukisa abo abatalaba, ate ne bakkiriza"; abo baliweebwa okuyingira okugazi ku nkomerero, n'olugendo olutafudde ku kkubo. Omusomi wange tajja kwesiga Katonda mu Kristo Yesu? Awo we mpummulira n'obwesige obw'essanyu. Owooluganda, jangu naffe, era kkiriza Kitaffe n'Omulokozi waffe. Jangu kaakati kennyini.

fields.title: Lwaki Tulokolebwa Olw'okukkiriza?
fields.body_html:
LWAKI TULOKOLEBWA OLW'OKUKKIRIZA?

LWAKI OKUKKIRIZA kwe kulondebwa okuba oluguudo lw'obulokozi? Tewali kubuusabuusa nti ekibuuzo kino kibuuzibwa emirundi mingi. “Olw'ekisa muwonyeddwa ku bw'okukkiriza,” mazima ge maka g'Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, era y'etteeka lya Katonda; naye lwaki kiri bwe kityo? Lwaki okukkiriza kwe kulondebwa mu kifo ky'essuubi, oba okwagala, oba obugumiikiriza?

Kitusaanira okuba abetoowaze nga tuddamu ekibuuzo ng'ekyo, kubanga amakubo ga Katonda tegatera kutegeerekeka; era tetukkirizibwa kugabuuza n'amalala. Mu buwombeefu twandiddemu nti, nga bwe tuyinza okukimanya, okukkiriza kwalondebwa okuba oluguudo lw'ekisa, kubanga mu kukkiriza mulimu obusobozi obw'obuzaaliranwa okukozesebwa ng'ekifuna. Ka twogere nti nnaatera okuwa omunaku ekirabo eky'obusaddaaka: nkiteeka mu ngalo ze -- lwaki? Weewaawo, tekyandisaanidde kukiteeka mu kutu kwe, oba okukissa ku kigere kye; omukono gulabika ng'ogwakolebwa lwa nsonga y'okufuna. Bwe kityo, mu ndowooza yaffe, okukkiriza kwatondebwa lwa nsonga y'okuba ekifuna: gwe mukono gw'omuntu, era waliwo obusaanira mu kufuna ekisa okuyita mu gwo.

Ka nkinnyonnyole bulungi ddala. Okukkiriza okufuna Kristo kikolwa kyangu nga bwe kiri ng'omwana wo bw'afuna apo okuva gy'oli, kubanga ogigolola n'omusuubiza okumuwa apo bw'agijjira. Okukkiriza n'okufuna byogera ku apo yokka; naye bikola kikolwa kye kimu ddala n'okukkiriza okukwatagana n'obulokozi obutaggwaawo. Ekyo omukono gw'omwana kye guli eri apo, n'okukkiriza kwo bwe kutyo eri obulokozi obutuukiridde obwa Kristo. Omukono gw'omwana teguwoola apo, so teguleeta apo, so tegusaanidde apo; gugifuna gyokka; era okukkiriza kwalondebwa Katonda okuba ekifuna ky'obulokozi, kubanga tekweefuula kutonda bulokozi, so si kubuyamba, naye kumativu okubufuna mu buwombeefu. “Okukkiriza lwe lulimi olusaba ekisa, gwe mukono ogukifuna, era liiso eririkiraba; naye si muwendo ogukigula.” Okukkiriza tekwefuula kirungamu kyakwo, kuteeka empaka zaakwo zonna ku musaayi gwa Kristo. Kufuuka omuweereza omulungi okuleeta obugagga bwa Mukama waffe Yesu eri omwoyo, kubanga kwatula gye kwabujja, ne kukkiriza nti ekisa kyokka kye kyakukwasa.

Nate, awatali kubuusabuusa, okukkiriza kwalondebwa kubanga kuwa Katonda ekitiibwa kyonna. Kiva mu kukkiriza kiryoke kibe olw'ekisa, era kiva mu kisa waleme kubaawo kwenyumiriza; kubanga Katonda tayinza kugumiikiriza malala. “Ab'amalala abamanyira ewala,” era taagala kubasemberera. Taliwa bulokozi mu ngeri erikubiriza oba erikuza amalala. Pawulo agamba nti, “Si lwa bikolwa, waleme kubaawo muntu yenna eyeenyumiriza.” Kaakano, okukkiriza kuggyawo okwenyumiriza kwonna. Omukono ogufuna ekirabo tegugamba nti, “Nsaanira okwebazibwa olw'okukkiriza ekirabo”; ekyo kyandibadde kya busirusiru. Omukono bwe gutwala omugaati mu kamwa tegugamba mubiri nti, “Mbaza; kubanga nkuliisa.” Kye kikola kintu kyangu nnyo newankubadde nga kya nsonga nnyo; era tekwepaatiikako kitiibwa ku ekyo kye gukola. Bw'atyo Katonda yalonda okukkiriza okufuna ekirabo eky'ekisa kye ekitayogerekeka, kubanga tekuyinza kwetwalira kitiibwa kyonna, naye kiteekwa okusinza Katonda ow'ekisa agaba ebirungi byonna. Okukkiriza kussa engule ku mutwe ogusaanira, era kyekyava Mukama Yesu ateranga okussa engule ku mutwe gw'okukkiriza, ng'agamba nti, “Okukkiriza kwo kukulokodde; genda mirembe.”

Ekiddako, Katonda alonda okukkiriza okuba oluguudo lw'obulokozi kubanga kkubo eritakyamya, erigatta omuntu ne Katonda. Omuntu bw'eesiga Katonda, wabaawo ekifo we bagattira, era okugatta okwo kukakasa omukisa. Okukkiriza kutulokola kubanga kutuleetera okwekwatako Katonda, ne kutuleeta mu nkolagana naye. Emirundi mingi nkozesezza ekifaananyi kino, naye nteekwa okukiddiŋŋaana, kubanga sisobola kulowooza kirala kisinga. Mbuulirwa nti emyaka mingi emabega eryato lyagwa waggulu w'ebiyiriro bya Niagara, era abasajja babiri ne batwalibwa amazzi, abantu abaali ku lubalama ne basobola okusindika omuguwa gye bali, ogwo omuguwa ne bagukwatako bombi. Omu ku bo n'agunywerera n'aggibwa mirembe okutuuka ku lukalu; naye omulala, bwe yalaba ekisiki ekinene nga kiseeyeeya, mu butategeera n'aleka omuguwa n'anywerera ku kisiki, kubanga kye kyali ekisinga obunene ku byombi, era nga kirabika nga kisinga okwekwatako. Zisanze! ekisiki n'omusajja gwe kyali kyetisse ne biwonoggoka mu bunnya obunene, kubanga tewaali kugatta wakati w'ekisiki n'olubalama. Obunene bw'ekisiki tebwagasa oyo eyakinywako; kyetaaga enkolagana n'olubalama okuleeta obulokozi. Bw'atyo omuntu bw'eyesiga ebikolwa bye, oba amasakramenti, oba ekintu kyonna eky'engeri eyo, talokolebwa, kubanga tewali kugatta wakati we ne Kristo; naye okukkiriza, newankubadde nga kulabika ng'omuguwa omutono, kuli mu mikono gya Katonda omukulu ali ku ludda lw'olubalama; amaanyi agatakoma gasika omuguwa oguyunga, bwe gutyo ne gusika omuntu okuva mu kuzikirira. Ye mukisa gw'okukkiriza, kubanga kutugatta ne Katonda!

Okukkiriza kulondebwa nate, kubanga kukwata ku nsibuko z'ebikolwa. N'ebintu ebya bulijjo, okukkiriza okw'engeri emu kuli mu misingi gya byonna. Neebuuza oba nnaaba nkyamu bwe njogera nti tewali kye tukola wabula nga tuyita mu kukkiriza okw'engeri emu. Bwe ntambula okuyita mu kisenge kyange eky'okusomeramu, kiba kubanga nzikiriza nti amagulu gange ganantwala. Omuntu alya kubanga akkiriza nti emmere yeetaagisa; agenda mu bizinensi kubanga akkiriza omuwendo gw'ensimbi; akkiriza cheki kubanga akkiriza nti bbanka egiwaliriza. Columbus yazuula America kubanga yakkiriza nti waaliwo ssemazinga omulala emitala w'ennyanja; ne Bakadde Abatambuze (Pilgrim Fathers) ne bagituula kubanga baakkiriza nti Katonda yandibadde nabo ku mbalama ziri ez'amayinja. Ebikolwa ebisinga obukulu byazaalibwa mu kukkiriza; ku bw'obulungi oba obubi, okukkiriza kukola eby'ekitalo mu muntu mwe kubeera. Okukkiriza mu ngeri yaakwo ey'obuzaaliranwa ge maanyi agawangula byonna, agayingira mu ngeri zonna ez'ebikolwa by'abantu. Kiyinzika nti oyo aduulira okukkiriza mu Katonda ye muntu alina okukkiriza okusingayo mu ngeri embi; mazima, atera okugwa mu bukkiriza obw'ekyejo obwandibadde obw'okusekererwa, singa tebwandibadde obuswaza. Katonda awa obulokozi eri okukkiriza, kubanga bw'atonda okukkiriza mu ffe akwata ku nsibuko entuufu ey'enneewulira n'ebikolwa byaffe. Ng'ayogera, atutte ku bbaatule, kaakano asobola okuweereza amasannyalaze amatukuvu mu kitundu kyonna eky'obuntu bwaffe. Bwe tukkiriza Kristo, n'omutima ne gujja mu mikono gya Katonda, olwo tulokolebwa okuva mu kibi, ne tusikibwa okwenenya, obutukuvu, obunyiikivu, okusaba, okwewaayo, ne buli kintu kyonna eky'ekisa. “Amafuta kye gali eri nnamuziga, ebizito kye biri eri essaawa, ebiwaawaatiro kye biri eri ennyonyi, ettanga kye liri eri ekyombo, okukkiriza bwe kutyo eri emirimu n'obuweereza obutukuvu bwonna.” Beera n'okukkiriza, era ebisa ebirala byonna bijja kugoberera ne bisigala nga bikwata ekkubo lyabyo.

Okukkiriza, nate, kulina amaanyi ag'okukola olw'okwagala; kukwata ku nneewulira eri Katonda, era kusika omutima eri ebintu ebisinga obulungi. Oyo akkiriza Katonda, awatali kubuusabuusa, ajja kwagala Katonda. Okukkiriza kikolwa ky'okutegeera; naye era kiva mu mutima. “Kubanga omutima gwe gukkiririza mu butuukirivu”; era kyekiva Katonda awa obulokozi eri okukkiriza kubanga kubeera kumpi n'enneewulira, era kuli luganda lwa kwagala; era okwagala kwe kuzaala era kwe kulabirira buli nneewulira n'ekikolwa ekitukuvu. Okwagala Katonda kwe kugondera, okwagala Katonda kwe butukuvu. Okwagala Katonda n'okwagala omuntu kwe kufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kya Kristo; era buno bwe bulokozi.

Ekirala, okukkiriza kuleeta emirembe n'essanyu; oyo alina kwo awummula, atereera, asanyuka era ajaguza, era kuno kwe kwetegekera eggulu. Katonda awa ebirabo byonna eby'omu ggulu eri okukkiriza, olw'ensonga eno mu ndala, nti okukkiriza kukolera mu ffe obulamu n'omwoyo ebiraga emirembe gyonna mu nsi ey'engulu esinga obulungi. Okukkiriza kutuwa ebyokulwanyisa eby'obulamu buno, n'okuyigirizibwa olw'obulamu obugenda okujja. Kusobozesa omuntu okubeera omulamu era n'okufa awatali kutya; kumutegekera okukola n'okubonaabona; era kyekiva Mukama akulonda okuba ekkubo erisinga okwanguyirwa okutuweereza ekisa, bw'atyo ne atukuuma olw'ekitiibwa.

Mazima okukkiriza kutukolera ekyo tewali kirala kiyinza kukola; kutuwa essanyu n'emirembe, era kutuyingiza mu kuwummula. Lwaki abantu bagezaako okufuna obulokozi mu ngeri endala? Omubuulizi ow'edda agamba nti, “Omuweereza omusirusiru gwe balagira okuggulawo oluggi, agusseeko ekibegabega kye n'asindika n'amaanyi ge gonna; naye oluggi terwenyeenya, so tasobola kuyingira, ne bw'akozesa amaanyi gonna g'alina. Omulala ajja n'ekisumuluzo, n'asumulula oluggi mangu, n'ayingira nga tafubye. Abo abaagala okulokolebwa olw'ebikolwa basindika oluggi lw'eggulu awatali kkubo; naye okukkiriza kye kisumuluzo ekiggulawo oluggi amangwago.” Ggwe asoma, tojja kukozesa kisumuluzo ekyo? Mukama akulagira okukkiriza mu Mwana we omwagalwa, kale osobola okukikola; era bw'okikola onoobeera mulamu. Kino si kye kisuubizo ky'enjiri, nti, “Akkiriza n'abatizibwa alirokolebwa”? (Makko 16:16). Kiki ky'oyinza okuwakanya mu kkubo ery'obulokozi eryesiimisa mu kusaasira n'amagezi aga Katonda waffe ow'ekisa?
