Okukkiriza n'okufuna byogera ku apo yokka; naye bikola kikolwa kye kimu ddala n'okukkiriza okukwatagana n'obulokozi obutaggwaawo. Ekyo omukono gw'omwana kye guli eri apo, n'okukkiriza kwo bwe kutyo eri obulokozi obutuukiridde obwa Kristo. Omukono gw'omwana teguwoola apo, so teguleeta apo, so tegusaanidde apo; gugifuna gyokka; era okukkiriza kwalondebwa Katonda okuba ekifuna ky'obulokozi, kubanga tekweefuula kutonda bulokozi, so si kubuyamba, naye kumativu okubufuna mu buwombeefu. "Okukkiriza lwe lulimi olusaba ekisa, gwe mukono ogukifuna, era liiso eririkiraba; naye si muwendo ogukigula." Okukkiriza tekwefuula kirungamu kyakwo, kuteeka empaka zaakwo zonna ku musaayi gwa Kristo. Kufuuka omuweereza omulungi okuleeta obugagga bwa Mukama waffe Yesu eri omwoyo, kubanga kwatula gye kwabujja, ne kukkiriza nti ekisa kyokka kye kyakukwasa. Nate, awatali kubuusabuusa, okukkiriza kwalondebwa kubanga kuwa Katonda ekitiibwa kyonna. Kiva mu kukkiriza kiryoke kibe olw'ekisa, era kiva mu kisa waleme kubaawo kwenyumiriza; kubanga Katonda tayinza kugumiikiriza malala. "Ab'amalala abamanyira ewala," era taagala kubasemberera. Taliwa bulokozi mu ngeri erikubiriza oba erikuza amalala. Pawulo agamba nti, "Si lwa bikolwa, waleme kubaawo muntu yenna eyeenyumiriza." Kaakano, okukkiriza kuggyawo okwenyumiriza kwonna. Omukono ogufuna ekirabo tegugamba nti, "Nsaanira okwebazibwa olw'okukkiriza ekirabo"; ekyo kyandibadde kya busirusiru. Omukono bwe gutwala omugaati mu kamwa tegugamba mubiri nti, "Mbaza; kubanga nkuliisa." Kye kikola kintu kyangu nnyo newankubadde nga kya nsonga nnyo; era tekwepaatiikako kitiibwa ku ekyo kye gukola. Bw'atyo Katonda yalonda okukkiriza okufuna ekirabo eky'ekisa kye ekitayogerekeka, kubanga tekuyinza kwetwalira kitiibwa kyonna, naye kiteekwa okusinza Katonda ow'ekisa agaba ebirungi byonna. Okukkiriza kussa engule ku mutwe ogusaanira, era kyekyava Mukama Yesu ateranga okussa engule ku mutwe gw'okukkiriza, ng'agamba nti, "Okukkiriza kwo kukulokodde; genda mirembe." Ekiddako, Katonda alonda okukkiriza okuba oluguudo lw'obulokozi kubanga kkubo eritakyamya, erigatta omuntu ne Katonda. Omuntu bw'eesiga Katonda, wabaawo ekifo we bagattira, era okugatta okwo kukakasa omukisa. Okukkiriza kutulokola kubanga kutuleetera okwekwatako Katonda, ne kutuleeta mu nkolagana naye. Emirundi mingi nkozesezza ekifaananyi kino, naye nteekwa okukiddiŋŋaana, kubanga sisobola kulowooza kirala kisinga. Mbuulirwa nti emyaka mingi emabega eryato lyagwa waggulu w'ebiyiriro bya Niagara, era abasajja babiri ne batwalibwa amazzi, abantu abaali ku lubalama ne basobola okusindika omuguwa gye bali, ogwo omuguwa ne bagukwatako bombi. Omu ku bo n'agunywerera n'aggibwa mirembe okutuuka ku lukalu; naye omulala, bwe yalaba ekisiki ekinene nga kiseeyeeya, mu butategeera n'aleka omuguwa n'anywerera ku kisiki, kubanga kye kyali ekisinga obunene ku byombi, era nga kirabika nga kisinga okwekwatako. Zisanze! ekisiki n'omusajja gwe kyali kyetisse ne biwonoggoka mu bunnya obunene, kubanga tewaali kugatta wakati w'ekisiki n'olubalama. Obunene bw'ekisiki tebwagasa oyo eyakinywako; kyetaaga enkolagana n'olubalama okuleeta obulokozi. Bw'atyo omuntu bw'eyesiga ebikolwa bye, oba amasakramenti, oba ekintu kyonna eky'engeri eyo, talokolebwa, kubanga tewali kugatta wakati we ne Kristo; naye okukkiriza, newankubadde nga kulabika ng'omuguwa omutono, kuli mu mikono gya Katonda omukulu ali ku ludda lw'olubalama; amaanyi agatakoma gasika omuguwa oguyunga, bwe gutyo ne gusika omuntu okuva mu kuzikirira. Ye mukisa gw'okukkiriza, kubanga kutugatta ne Katonda! Okukkiriza kulondebwa nate, kubanga kukwata ku nsibuko z'ebikolwa. N'ebintu ebya bulijjo, okukkiriza okw'engeri emu kuli mu misingi gya byonna. Neebuuza oba nnaaba nkyamu bwe njogera nti tewali kye tukola wabula nga tuyita mu kukkiriza okw'engeri emu. Bwe ntambula okuyita mu kisenge kyange eky'okusomeramu, kiba kubanga nzikiriza nti amagulu gange ganantwala. Omuntu alya kubanga akkiriza nti emmere yeetaagisa; agenda mu bizinensi kubanga akkiriza omuwendo gw'ensimbi; akkiriza cheki kubanga akkiriza nti bbanka egiwaliriza. Columbus yazuula America kubanga yakkiriza nti waaliwo ssemazinga omulala emitala w'ennyanja; ne Bakadde Abatambuze (Pilgrim Fathers) ne bagituula kubanga baakkiriza nti Katonda yandibadde nabo ku mbalama ziri ez'amayinja. Ebikolwa ebisinga obukulu byazaalibwa mu kukkiriza; ku bw'obulungi oba obubi, okukkiriza kukola eby'ekitalo mu muntu mwe kubeera. Okukkiriza mu ngeri yaakwo ey'obuzaaliranwa ge maanyi agawangula byonna, agayingira mu ngeri zonna ez'ebikolwa by'abantu. Kiyinzika nti oyo aduulira okukkiriza mu Katonda ye muntu alina okukkiriza okusingayo mu ngeri embi; mazima, atera okugwa mu bukkiriza obw'ekyejo obwandibadde obw'okusekererwa, singa tebwandibadde obuswaza. Katonda awa obulokozi eri okukkiriza, kubanga bw'atonda okukkiriza mu ffe akwata ku nsibuko entuufu ey'enneewulira n'ebikolwa byaffe. Ng'ayogera, atutte ku bbaatule, kaakano asobola okuweereza amasannyalaze amatukuvu mu kitundu kyonna eky'obuntu bwaffe. Bwe tukkiriza Kristo, n'omutima ne gujja mu mikono gya Katonda, olwo tulokolebwa okuva mu kibi, ne tusikibwa okwenenya, obutukuvu, obunyiikivu, okusaba, okwewaayo, ne buli kintu kyonna eky'ekisa. "Amafuta kye gali eri nnamuziga, ebizito kye biri eri essaawa, ebiwaawaatiro kye biri eri ennyonyi, ettanga kye liri eri ekyombo, okukkiriza bwe kutyo eri emirimu n'obuweereza obutukuvu bwonna." Beera n'okukkiriza, era ebisa ebirala byonna bijja kugoberera ne bisigala nga bikwata ekkubo lyabyo. Okukkiriza, nate, kulina amaanyi ag'okukola olw'okwagala; kukwata ku nneewulira eri Katonda, era kusika omutima eri ebintu ebisinga obulungi. Oyo akkiriza Katonda, awatali kubuusabuusa, ajja kwagala Katonda. Okukkiriza kikolwa ky'okutegeera; naye era kiva mu mutima. "Kubanga omutima gwe gukkiririza mu butuukirivu"; era kyekiva Katonda awa obulokozi eri okukkiriza kubanga kubeera kumpi n'enneewulira, era kuli luganda lwa kwagala; era okwagala kwe kuzaala era kwe kulabirira buli nneewulira n'ekikolwa ekitukuvu. Okwagala Katonda kwe kugondera, okwagala Katonda kwe butukuvu. Okwagala Katonda n'okwagala omuntu kwe kufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kya Kristo; era buno bwe bulokozi. Ekirala, okukkiriza kuleeta emirembe n'essanyu; oyo alina kwo awummula, atereera, asanyuka era ajaguza, era kuno kwe kwetegekera eggulu. Katonda awa ebirabo byonna eby'omu ggulu eri okukkiriza, olw'ensonga eno mu ndala, nti okukkiriza kukolera mu ffe obulamu n'omwoyo ebiraga emirembe gyonna mu nsi ey'engulu esinga obulungi. Okukkiriza kutuwa ebyokulwanyisa eby'obulamu buno, n'okuyigirizibwa olw'obulamu obugenda okujja. Kusobozesa omuntu okubeera omulamu era n'okufa awatali kutya; kumutegekera okukola n'okubonaabona; era kyekiva Mukama akulonda okuba ekkubo erisinga okwanguyirwa okutuweereza ekisa, bw'atyo ne atukuuma olw'ekitiibwa. Mazima okukkiriza kutukolera ekyo tewali kirala kiyinza kukola; kutuwa essanyu n'emirembe, era kutuyingiza mu kuwummula. Lwaki abantu bagezaako okufuna obulokozi mu ngeri endala? Omubuulizi ow'edda agamba nti, "Omuweereza omusirusiru gwe balagira okuggulawo oluggi, agusseeko ekibegabega kye n'asindika n'amaanyi ge gonna; naye oluggi terwenyeenya, so tasobola kuyingira, ne bw'akozesa amaanyi gonna g'alina. Omulala ajja n'ekisumuluzo, n'asumulula oluggi mangu, n'ayingira nga tafubye. Abo abaagala okulokolebwa olw'ebikolwa basindika oluggi lw'eggulu awatali kkubo; naye okukkiriza kye kisumuluzo ekiggulawo oluggi amangwago." Ggwe asoma, tojja kukozesa kisumuluzo ekyo? Mukama akulagira okukkiriza mu Mwana we omwagalwa, kale osobola okukikola; era bw'okikola onoobeera mulamu. Kino si kye kisuubizo ky'enjiri, nti, "Akkiriza n'abatizibwa alirokolebwa"? (Makko 16:16). Kiki ky'oyinza okuwakanya mu kkubo ery'obulokozi eryesiimisa mu kusaasira n'amagezi aga Katonda waffe ow'ekisa?

fields.title: Woowe! Sisobola Kukola Kintu!
fields.body_html:
WOOWE! SISOBOLA KUKOLA KINTU!

OLUVANNYUMA OMUTIMA OGWEERALIIKIRIDDE lwe gumaze okukkiriza enjigiriza ey'okutangirira, ne guyiga amazima amakulu nti obulokozi buva mu kukkiriza Mukama Yesu, emirundi mingi guba gunakuwavu nnyo olw'okuwulira obutasobola kukola kirungi. Bangi bakaaba nti, “Sisobola kukola kintu.” Tekiba nsonga gye bawaayo yokka, wabula bakiwulira ng'omugugu ogwa buli lunaku. Bandikikoze singa bandisobodde. Buli omu ayinza okwogera mu bwesimbu nti, “Okwagala kundiko, naye engeri y'okukola kye njagala sigirabako.”

Okuwulira kuno kulabika ng'okufuula Enjiri yonna nga teraaba na makulu; kubanga emmere egasa ki omuntu alumwa enjala bw'atagituukako? Omugga gw'amazzi ag'obulamu gugasa ki omuntu bw'atagunywa? Tujjukira olugero lw'omusawo n'omwana w'omukazi omwavu. Omusawo omugezi yagamba nnyina nti omwana we ajja kuwona mangu bw'anaajjanjabibwa obulungi, naye kyali kyetaagisa nnyo nti omulenzi we anywenga buli lunaku wayini asinga obulungi, era amale ekiseera mu kifo eky'amazzi ag'eddagala mu Bugirimaani. Kino, eri nnamwandu eyali tasobola na kufuna mmere ya kulya! Kaakano, oluusi kirabika eri omutima ogweeraliikiridde ng'Enjiri entangaavu ey'okugamba nti “Kkiriza obeere mulamu,” si nnyangu nnyo bwe kityo; kubanga esaba omwonoonyi omwavu okukola ky'atasobola kukola. Eri oyo azuukuse ddala naye nga tannayigirizibwa bulungi, walabika ng'ekyunga ekibulako; laba obulokozi bwa Yesu buli wali, naye buyinza kutuukibwako butya? Emmeeme terina maanyi, era temanyi kya kukola. Egalamidde ng'eraba ekibuga eky'obuddukiro, naye nga tesobola kuyingira mu mulyango gwakyo.

Obutaba na maanyi kuno kwakisibwako mu nteekateeka y'obulokozi? Weewaawo. Omulimu gwa Mukama mutuukirivu. Gutandikira we tuli, era tegutwetaagisa kintu kyonna okugutuukiriza. Omusamaliya omulungi bwe yalaba omutambuze ng'agalamidde ng'afumitiddwa era ng'afu omutwe, teyamugamba kuyimuka kujja gy'ali, kulinnya ku ndogoyi n'agenda mu nnyumba y'abagenyi. Nedda, “yajja we yali,” n'amujjanjaba, n'amuwanika ku nsolo n'amutwala mu nnyumba y'abagenyi. Bw'atyo Mukama Yesu bw'atukola mu mbeera yaffe eya wansi era ennaku.

Tulabye nti Katonda awa obutuukirivu, nti awa obutuukirivu abatatya Katonda, era nti abawa obutuukirivu ng'ayita mu kukkiriza omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw'omuwendo; kaakano tulina okulaba embeera abatatya Katonda bano gye baba bali Yesu ng'akola obulokozi bwabwe. Abantu bangi abazuukuse tebeeraliikirira bibi byabwe byokka, wabula n'obunafu bwabwe mu mpisa. Tebalina maanyi ga kuvaamu mu bitosi mwe bagudde, wadde okwewala okuddamu okugwamu mu nnaku ez'omu maaso. Tebakungubagira ku kye bakoze kyokka, wabula ne ku kye batasobola kukola. Beewulira nga tebalina maanyi, nga tebalina buyambi, era nga bafu mu mwoyo. Kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekitasaana okugamba nti beewulira nga bafu, kyokka bwe kiri bwe kityo. Mu ndowooza yaabwe, tebasobola kukola kirungi kyonna. Tebasobola kutambula luguudo oluggya mu ggulu, kubanga amagumba gaabwe gamenyese. “Tewali n'omu ku basajja ab'amaanyi eyalaba emikono gye;” mu butuufu, “tebalina maanyi.” Eky'essanyu, kyawandiikibwa, ng'okutendereza okwagala kwa Katonda gye tuli:

Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda (Abaruumi 5:6).

Wano tulaba obutaba na buyambi obumanyiddwa nga buyambibwa--nga buyambibwa olw'okweyingiza kwa Mukama Yesu. Obutaba na buyambi bwaffe bwa kkomo. Tekyawandiikibwa nti, “Bwe twali abanafu katono Kristo yatufiirira”; oba, “Bwe twali n'amaanyi matono”; wabula okunnyonnyola kujjuvu era tekuliiko kkomo; “Bwe twali tukyali abanafu.” Twali tetulina maanyi n'akatono agandiyambye mu bulokozi bwaffe; ebigambo bya Mukama waffe byali bya mazima ddala, “Awatali nze temuyinza kukola kintu.” Nnyinza okweyongerayo okusinga ekyawandiikibwa, ne mbajjukiza okwagala okungi Mukama kwe yatwagala nakwo, “ne bwe twali abafu olw'ebyonoono n'ebibi.” Okuba omufu kusinga n'okuba nga tolina maanyi.

Ekintu ekimu omwonoonyi omwavu atalina maanyi ky'alina okussaako omwoyo gwe, n'akinyweza, ng'omusingi gwe ogumu ogw'essuubi, ye ndagaano ya Katonda nti “mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Kkiriza kino, n'obutasobola bwonna bujja kubula. Nga bwe kigero ku Midas nti buli kye yakwatako yakifuula zaabu, bwe kityo bwe kiri ku kukkiriza nti buli kye kukwatako kukifuula kirungi. Byetaago byaffe n'obunafu bwaffe bifuuka mikisa okukkiriza bwe kubikwatako.

Katuzimbe ku ngeri ezimu ez'obutaba na maanyi buno. Okusooka, omuntu omu anaayogera nti, “Ssebo, sirabika nga nnina amaanyi ga kukungaanya birowoozo byange, ne mbinyweza ku nsonga zino enzito ezikwata ku bulokozi bwange; n'okusaba okumpi kunfuukira kunene nnyo. Kiri bwe kityo, oboolyawo, olw'obunafu obw'obuzaaliranwa, ekitundu kimu olw'okweyonoona nga nneenyigidde mu bwenzi, ate n'ekitundu olw'okweeraliikirira eby'ensi, ne siba na busobozi bw'ebirowoozo ebya waggulu ebyetaagisa ng'emmeeme tennalokolebwa.” Eno ngeri nnene nnyo ey'obunafu obw'ekibi. Wuliriza kino! Toliiko maanyi ku nsonga eno; era waliwo bangi abali nga ggwe. Tebandisobodde kugoberera lunyiriri lwa birowoozo olutabalako wadde okuwonya obulamu bwabwe. Abasajja n'abakazi bangi abaavu tebamanyi kusoma era tebayigirizibwa, era bano bandisanze okulowooza okw'amaanyi nga mulimu muzito nnyo. Abalala baba bangu era ba butafaayo mu buzaaliranwa, ne batasobola kugoberera nkola nnene ey'empaka n'okulowooza, nga bwe batayinza kubuuka. Tebandituuse ku kumanya ekyama kyonna eky'amaanyi ne bwe bandimazeeko obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Noolwekyo, tosaana kuggwaamu ssuubi: ekyetaagisa mu bulokozi si kulowooza okutasala, wabula okwesiga Yesu okwangu. Nyweza ku kintu kino ekimu-- “Mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Amazima gano tegaakwetaagise kunoonyereza kwa maanyi wadde okulowooza okw'amaanyi, oba empaka ezikakasa. Kiri wali: “Mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Ssaako omwoyo gwo ku ekyo, era owummulire eyo.

Amazima gano agamu amakulu, ag'ekisa, ag'ekitiibwa gabeere mu mwoyo gwo okutuusa lwe ganaawunyisa ebirowoozo byo byonna akaloosa akalungi, ne gakusanyusa wadde nga toliiko maanyi, ng'olaba nga Mukama Yesu afuuse amaanyi go n'oluyimba lwo, weewaawo, afuuse obulokozi bwo. Ng'Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba, kya mazima ekyabikkulwa, nti mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda nga bakyali abanafu. Oyinza okuba nga owulidde ebigambo bino emirundi ebikumi, kyokka nga tewali we wategeeredde makulu gaabyo. Waliwo akaloosa akasanyusa akabyo, si bwe kiri? Yesu teyafiirira butuukirivu bwaffe, wabula yafiirira ebibi byaffe. Teyajja kutulokola lwa kubanga twali tusaanira okulokolebwa, wabula lwa kubanga twali tetugasa ku bwonna, nga tuzikiridde, era nga twonoonese. Teyajja ku nsi lwa nsonga yonna eyali mu ffe, wabula lwa nsonga zokka ze yaggya mu buziba bw'okwagala kwe okutukuvu. Mu kiseera ekituufu yafiirira abo b'ayogerako, si nga abatya Katonda, wabula nga abatatya Katonda, ng'abawa erinnya erisinga obw'obutasuubira bw'ayinza okulonda. Bw'oba n'omutwe mutono, era gunyweze ku mazima gano, agagera ku busobozi obusinga obutono, era agasobola okusanyusa omutima ogusinga okuzitowa. Ekigambo kino kibeere wansi w'olulimi lwo ng'akantu akawoomerera, okutuusa lwe kanaasaanuukira mu mutima gwo ne kawoomya ebirowoozo byo byonna; olwo tekyakuluma wadde ebirowoozo ebyo nga bisaasaanye ng'ebikoola ebiwuguma mu mpewo. Abantu abatalabikanga mu by'ensayansi, wadde okulaga akatono ak'obusobozi obw'omutwe, naye baasobola bulungi okukkiriza enjigiriza y'omusaalaba, ne balokolebwa mu yo. Lwaki ggwe teyandikoze bwe kityo?

Mpulira omulala ng'akaaba nti, “Woowe, ssebo obutaba na maanyi bwange businga kubeera mu kino, nti sisobola kwenenya kumala!” Endowooza ey'ekyewuunyo abantu gye balina ku kye kwenenya kwe! Bangi balowooza nti amaziga mangi ge gasaana okukulukuta, n'okusinda okungi kwe kusaana okuwulirwa, n'obutasuubira obungi bwe busaana okugumiikirizibwa. Endowooza eno etaliimu makulu eva wa? Obutakkiriza n'obutasuubira bibi, era noolwekyo sirengera engeri gye biyinza okubeeramu ebitundu ebikola okwenenya okukkirizibwa; kyokka waliwo bangi ababiraba ng'ebitundu ebyetaagisa eby'obulamu bw'Omukristaayo ow'amazima. Bali mu nsobi nnene. Naye kyokka, mmanyi kye bategeeza, kubanga mu nnaku z'ekizikiza kyange nnali njogera bwe ntyo. Nnayagala okwenenya, naye nnalowooza nti sisobola kukikola, kyokka ekiseera kyonna nga nnenenya. Wadde nga kiwulikika ng'eky'ekyewuunyo, nnawulira nga sisobola kuwulira. Nnayinganga mu nsonda ne nkaaba, kubanga nnali sisobola kukaaba; era nnagwa mu nnaku enkambwe kubanga nnali sisobola kunakuwalira kibi. Kizibu ki kino kyonna nga mu mbeera yaffe ey'obutakkiriza tutandika okusalira embeera yaffe omusango! Kiri ng'omuzibe amaaso ng'atunuulira amaaso ge ye. Omutima gwange gwasaanuuka munda yange olw'okutya, kubanga nnalowooza nti omutima gwange mukakanyavu ng'ejjinja ery'adamanti. Omutima gwange gwamenyeka olw'okulowooza nti teguumenyeke. Kaakano nsobola okulaba nti nnali ndaga ekintu kyennyini kye nnalowooza nti sirina; naye mu kiseera ekyo nnali simanyi we nnali.

Singa nnasobola okuyamba abalala okuyingira mu kitangaala kye nsanyukira kaakano! Nnandyagadde okwogera ekigambo ekiyinza okukendeeza ku budde bw'okubuluŋŋanya kwabwe. Nnandyogedde ebigambo bitono ebyeyoleka, ne nsaba “Omubudaabudi” abisseeko ku mutima.

Jjukira nti omuntu eyeenenya mu mazima taamatire ku kwenenya kwe ye. Tetusobola kwenenya bulungi ddala nga bwe tutasobola kubeera balamu bulungi ddala. Ne bwe gaba amaziga gaffe amayonjo gatya, gajja kubeeramu obucaafu obumu: wajja kubaawo ekintu eky'okwenenyezaako ne mu kwenenya kwaffe okusinga obulungi. Naye wuliriza! Okwenenya kwe kukyusa endowooza yo ku kibi, ne ku Kristo, ne ku bintu byonna ebikulu ebya Katonda. Mu kino mulimu ennaku; naye ekikulu kwe kukyusa omutima okuva mu kibi okudda eri Kristo. Bwe wabaawo okukyuka kuno, oba olina obukulu bw'okwenenya okw'amazima, wadde nga tewali kutya wadde butasuubira ebyali biteeka ekisiikirize kyabyo ku ndowooza yo.

Bw'oba nga tosobola kwenenya nga bw'oyagala, kijja kukuyamba nnyo okukikola bw'onookkiririza ddala nti “mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Kirowoozeeko emirundi n'emirundi. Oyinza otya okusigala ng'olina omutima omukakanyavu ng'omanyi nti olw'okwagala okusingayo “Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda”? Ka nkusendasende okwewuunuza bw'oti: Newankubadde ndi mutatya Katonda, era wadde omutima guno ogw'ekyuma teguuwuluke, wadde nga nneekuba mu kifuba awatali kugasa, kyokka yafiirira abali nga nze, kubanga yafiirira abatatya Katonda. Woowe singa nnakkiriza kino ne mpulira amaanyi gaakyo ku mutima gwange ogukaluubidde!

Sangula buli ndowooza endala mu mwoyo gwo, otuule essaawa ku ssaawa, ofumiitirize nnyo ku kwolesebwa kuno okumu okumasamasa okw'okwagala okutasaanidwa, okutasuubirwa, okutalina kifaananyi, “Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Soma n'obwegendereza ebyafaayo by'okufa kwa Mukama, nga bw'obisanga mu bawandiisi b'Enjiri abana. Bwe wabaawo ekiyinza okusaanuusa omutima gwo omukakanyavu, kijja kuba kwe kulaba okubonaabona kwa Yesu, n'okulowooza nti yabonaabona bino byonna ku lw'abalabe be.

Ayi Yesu! amaziga ge nkulukusa gawooma, Nga nfukamidde ku bigere byo,

Ne ntunuulira omutwe gwo ogufumitiddwa, oguzirika, N'awulira ennaku zo zonna.

Omutima gwange gusaanuuka okukulaba ng'ovaamu omusaayi, Omutima guno ogwali omukakanyavu edda;

Nkuwulira ng'osabira abazza omusango, N'ennaku zeeyongera okukulukuta.

Wafiirira aboonoonyi, Nange omwonoonyi nnyimiridde:

Nkakasibwa eriiso lyo eriggwaamu obulamu, Nzitiddwa omukono gwo ogwafumitibwa.

Mazima ddala omusaalaba gwe muggo ogw'ebyamagero ogusobola okuggya amazzi mu lwazi. Bw'ategeera amakulu amajjuvu ag'ekiweebwayo kya Yesu eky'obwakatonda, olina okwenenya olw'okuba nga wali oyolekedde Oyo ajjudde okwagala. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Balitunuulira oyo gwe baafumita, ne bamukungubagira ng'omuntu bw'akungubagira omwana we omu yekka, era balimunakuwalira ng'omuntu anakuwalira omwana we omubereberye.” Okwenenya tekujja kukusobozesa kulaba Kristo; naye okulaba Kristo kujja kukuwa okwenenya. Toyinza kukola Kristo ng'omuggya mu kwenenya kwo, naye olina okunoonya okwenenya okuva eri Kristo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng'atukyusa okudda eri Kristo, atukyusa okuva mu kibi. Kale, tunula okuva ku kivaamu okudda ku nsibuko, okuva ku kwenenya kwo okudda eri Mukama Yesu, agulumizibbwa waggulu okuwa okwenenya.

Mpulidde omulala ng'agamba nti, “Mbonyaabonyezebwa ebirowoozo ebitiisa. Buli gye ŋŋenda, okuvvoola kunneeyingiza. Emirundi mingi nga nkola omulimu gwange, endowooza embi ennyo eneekakaako, era ne ku kitanda kyange nzuukuka mu tulo olw'okwasomooza kw'oyo omubi. Sisobola kuva mu kukemebwa kuno okw'entiisa.” Munnange, mmanyi kye otegeeza, kubanga nange nawambibwa omusege guno. Omuntu ayinza okusuubira okulwanyisa ekibinja ky'ensowera n'ekitala nga bw'ayinza okufuga ebirowoozo bye Setaani bw'abisindika. Emmeeme eyavu ekemebwa, elumbibwa endowooza za Setaani, eri ng'omutambuze gwe nnasoma, eyajjirwa ekibinja ky'enjuki ezaali zisunguwadde ku mutwe ne ku matu ne ku mubiri gwe gwonna. Teyasobola kuziziyiza wadde okuzidduka. Zaamulumira wonna era zaayagala okumutta. Sewuunya bw'owulira nti toliiko maanyi ga kuziyiza birowoozo bino ebibi era eby'ekivve Setaani by'afuka mu mwoyo gwo; naye kyokka nnandikujjukiza Ekyawandiikibwa ekiri mu maaso gaffe--“Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Yesu yamanya we twali era we twandibadde; yalaba nga tetusobola kuwangula omulangira ow'obuyinza obw'omu mpewo; yamanya nga twandibonyeebonyezebbwa nnyo naye; naye ne mu kiseera ekyo, bwe yatulaba nga tuli mu mbeera eyo, Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda. Ssuula essikiro ly'okukkiriza kwo ku kino. Setaani yennyini tasobola kukugamba nti si mutatya Katonda; kale kkiriza nti Yesu yafiirira n'abali nga ggwe. Jjukira engeri Martin Luther gye yasalamu omutwe gwa Setaani n'ekitala kye ye. “Woowe,” Setaani bwe yagamba Martin Luther, “oli mwonoonyi.” “Yee,” n'agamba, “Kristo yafa okulokola aboonoonyi.” Bw'atyo n'amukuba n'ekitala kye ye. Weekweke mu buddukiro buno, era osigale omwo: “Mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Bw'onoonyweera ku mazima ago, ebirowoozo byo eby'okuvvoola by'otoliiko maanyi ga kugoba bijja kwegendera byokka; kubanga Setaani ajja kulaba nti tewali ky'agenderera bw'akutawaanya nabyo.

Ebirowoozo bino, bw'obikyawa, si byo, wabula kuteeka kwa Setaani, ye gw'avunaanibwa, so si ggwe. Bw'obilwanyisa, tebiba byo, nga bwe bitali byo okukolima n'obulimba bw'abeeyongobezi mu luguudo. Setaani ayita mu birowoozo bino okukusindika mu butasuubira, oba okumpi kukuziyiza okwesiga Yesu. Omukazi omulwadde omwavu teyasobola kutuuka ku Yesu olw'ekibiina, era naawe oli mu mbeera y'emu, olw'okunyigirizibwa n'ekibiina ky'ebirowoozo bino ebitiisa. Kyokka, yagolola olugalo lwe, n'akwata ku mukugiro gw'ekyambalo kya Mukama, n'awonyezebwa. Kola bwe kityo naawe.

Yesu yafiirira abo abazza omusango olw'”ebibi n'okuvvoola kwonna,” era noolwekyo nkakasa nti tajja kugaana abo abawambiddwa ebirowoozo ebibi awatali kwagala kwabwe. Weesuule ku ye, awamu n'ebirowoozo byo byonna, olabe obanga si wa maanyi kulokola. Asobola okusirisa okwasomooza kw'omubi okutiisa okwo, oba asobola okukusobozesa okubiraba mu kitangaala kyabyo eky'amazima, oleme okutawaanyizibwa nabyo. Mu ngeri ye ye asobola era ajja kukulokola, era ku nkomerero akuwe emirembe emituukirivu. Mwesige yekka ku kino ne ku buli kintu ekirala.

Kya nnaku era kya kubuluŋŋanya engeri eyo ey'obutasobola eri mu kirowoozo eky'obutaba na buyinza bwa kukkiriza. Tetuli bagenyi eri okukaaba:

Woowe singa nnakkiriza,
Olwo byonna byandyanguyiddwa;
Nnaagala, naye sisobola; Mukama, mmalako,
Obuyambi bwange buteekwa okuva gy'oli.

Bangi basigala mu kizikiza okumala emyaka mingi kubanga tebalina maanyi, nga bwe bagamba, ga kukola ekyo ekiri okuleka amaanyi gonna n'okwewummuza mu maanyi g'omulala, ye Mukama Yesu. Mazima ddala, kya kyewuunyo nnyo, ensonga eno yonna ey'okukkiriza; kubanga abantu tebafuna buyambi bungi olw'okugezaako okukkiriza. Okukkiriza tekuva mu kugezaako. Singa omuntu yayogera ekigambo eky'ekintu ekibaddewo leero, sandimugambye nti nnaagezaako okumukkiriza. Singa nnakkiririza mu mazima g'omuntu eyantegeeza ekyo era n'agamba nti yakiraba, nnandikkirizza ekigambo mangu. Singa nnali simulaba ng'omuntu ow'amazima, mazima nnandimutakkirizza; naye tewandibadde kugezaako mu nsonga eyo. Kaakano, Katonda bw'alangirira nti waliwo obulokozi mu Kristo Yesu, nteekwa oba okumukkiriza mangu, oba okumufuula mulimba. Mazima ddala tojja kubuusabuusa ku luguudo oluluŋŋamu mu nsonga eno. Obujulizi bwa Katonda buteekwa okuba obwa mazima, era tuwaliriziddwa okukkiriza Yesu mangu.

Naye oboolyawo obadde ogezaako okukkiriza ennyo. Kaakano teweeteeka ku bintu bikulu. Matira okuba n'okukkiriza okusobola okukwata mu mukono gwakwo amazima gano agamu, “Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lw'abantu nga bakyali tebamukkiriza, era nga tebasobola kumukkiriza. Yafiirira abantu, si nga abakkiriza, wabula nga aboonoonyi. Yajja okufuula aboonoonyi bano abakkiriza n'abatukuvu; naye bwe yabafiirira yabalaba nga tebalina maanyi n'akatono. Bw'onyweera ku mazima nti Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda, era n'okukkiriza, okukkiriza kwo kujja kukulokola, era oyinza okugenda mirembe. Bw'onooteeka emmeeme yo mu mikono gya Yesu, eyafiirira abatatya Katonda, wadde nga tosobola kukkiriza bintu byonna, wadde okusiimuula ensozi, wadde okukola omulimu omulala gwonna ogw'ekyewuunyo, kyokka olokoseddwa. Si kukkiriza kunene, wabula okukkiriza okw'amazima, kwe kulokola; era obulokozi tebuli mu kukkiriza, wabula mu Kristo okukkiriza mwe kwesiga. Okukkiriza okwenkana n'empeke ya kaamwanyi kujja kuleeta obulokozi. Si kigero ky'okukkiriza, wabula obwesimbu bw'okukkiriza, kye kintu ekisaana okulowoozebwako. Mazima ddala omuntu asobola okukkiriza ky'amanyi nti kya mazima; era nga bw'omanyi nti Yesu wa mazima, ggwe, munnange, osobola okumukkiriza.

Omusaalaba, gwe kigendererwa ky'okukkiriza, era gwe nsibuko yaakwo, olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tuula otunuulire Omulokozi ng'afa okutuusa okukkiriza lwe kunaavaayo lwokka mu mutima gwo. Tewali kifo kiri nga Kalvary ku kutondawo obwesige. Empewo ey'olusozi olwo olutukuvu ereeta obulamu eri okukkiriza okukankana. Bangi abaabeera eyo baagamba nti:

Nga nkutunuulira, ng'ofumitiddwa, ng'onakuwadde, Nga tokyassa ku muti omukolimire,

Mukama, mpulira omutima gwange nga gukkiriza Nti wabonaabona bw'otyo ku lwange.

“Woowe!” omulala akaaba, “obutaba na maanyi bwange buli mu ludda luno, nti sisobola kuleka kibi kyange, era mmanyi nti sisobola kugenda mu ggulu nga neetisse ekibi kyange.” Nsanyuka nti okimanyi, kubanga kya mazima ddala. Oteekwa okwawukana ku kibi kyo, oba toyinza kufumbirwa Kristo. Jjukira ekibuuzo ekyayingira mu birowoozo bya Bunyan omuvubuka bwe yali mu mizannyo gye ku ttale ku Ssande: “Onooba n'ebibi byo n'ogenda mu muliro, oba onooleka ebibi byo n'ogenda mu ggulu?” Ekyo kyamuyimiriza ddala. Ekyo kye kibuuzo buli muntu ky'anaateekwa okuddamu: kubanga tewali kweyongera mu kibi ng'ogenda mu ggulu. Ekyo tekiyinza kubaawo. Oteekwa okuleka ekibi oba okuleka essuubi. Oddamu nti, “Yee, njagala bulungi. Okwagala kundiko, naye engeri y'okukola kye njagala sigirabako. Ekibi kimfuga, era siriiko maanyi.” Jjangu, kale, bw'oba nga toliiko maanyi, ekigambo kino kikyali kya mazima, “Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Okyasobola okukikkiriza? Ne bwe biba ebintu ebirala birabika ng'ebikuwakanya, onookikkiriza? Katonda akigambye, era kya mazima; noolwekyo, kinyweze ng'okufa, kubanga essuubi lyo lyokka liri omwo. Kkiriza kino era wesige Yesu, era mangu ojja kufuna amaanyi ge onoosaanyaawo ekibi kyo; naye awatali ye, omuntu ow'amaanyi eyeewanvuya ajja kukukwata emirembe gyonna ng'omuddu we omusibe. Nze kennyini, sandita nnasobola kuwangula bibi byange. Nnagezaako ne nnema. Emize gyange emibi gyali mingi nnyo okunsinga, okutuusa, mu kukkiriza nti Kristo yanfiirira, bwe nnasuula emmeeme yange erina omusango ku ye, olwo ne mfuna omusingi ogugumye kwe nnawangulira nze omwonoonyi. Enjigiriza y'omusaalaba eyinza okukozesebwa okutta ekibi, nga n'abalwanyi ab'edda bwe baakozesa ebitala byabwe ebinene eby'emikono ebiri, ne batemako abalabe baabwe buli lwe baakuba. Tewali kiri ng'okukkiriza mu Mukwano gw'omwonoonyi: kuwangula obubi bwonna. Kristo bw'aba yanfiirira, nga ndi mutatya Katonda, nga siriiko maanyi, kale siyinza kweyongera kubeera mu kibi, wabula nteekwa okwezuukusa okwagala n'okuweereza Oyo eyannunula. Siyinza kukolako na bubi obwatta Mukwano gwange omulungi. Nteekwa okuba omutukuvu ku lulwe. Nnyinza ntya okubeera mu kibi ng'afudde okundokola mu kyo?

Laba obuyambi obulungi nnyo buno bwe buli gy'oli atalina maanyi, okumanya n'okukkiriza nti mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda ng'abali nga ggwe. Otegedde endowooza? Mu ngeri emu, kizibu nnyo eri ebirowoozo byaffe ebikwafuwalidde, ebiriimu obukyayi, era ebitakkiriza okulaba obukulu bw'Enjiri. Oluusi nnalowooza, nga mmaze okubuulira, nti ntese Enjiri bulungi nnyo, nti n'ennyindo ku maaso g'omuntu teyandibadde nnyangu kulaba okusingawo; kyokka ntegeera nti n'abawuliriza abagezi baalemwa okutegeera amakulu ga “Muntunuulire mulokolebwe.” Abakyuse batera okugamba nti tebaamanya Enjiri okutuusa ku lunaku luli n'oluli; kyokka baali bagiwulidde okumala emyaka. Enjiri temanyiddwa, si lwa kubulwa nnyonnyola, wabula lwa butabaawo kwabikkulirwa kwa muntu ye kinnoomu. Kuno Omwoyo Omutukuvu yeeteeseteese okukuwa, era ajja kukuwa abo abamusaba. Kyokka bwe kuweebwa, omugatte gw'amazima agabikkulwa gonna gali mu bigambo bino: “Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.”

Mpulira omulala nga yeekaabya bw'ati: “Woowe, ssebo, obunafu bwange buli mu kino, nti sirabika nga nsigala nga ndi mu ndowooza emu okumala ebbanga! Mpulira ekigambo ku Ssande, ne nkwatibwako; naye mu wiiki nsisinkana munnange omubi, n'enneewulira zange ennungi zonna ne ziggwaawo. Bakozi bannange tebalina kye bakkiriza, era boogera ebintu ebibi ennyo, ne sitegeera ngeri ya kubaddamu, ne neesanga nga nziduka.” Mmumanyi bulungi ono Omugonvu Omuteefu, era mmukankanira; naye mu kiseera kye kimu, bw'aba ng'ali mwesimbu ddala, obunafu bwe busobola okuyambibwa ekisa kya Katonda. Omwoyo Omutukuvu asobola okugoba omwoyo omubi ogw'okutya omuntu. Asobola okufuula omuti omuzira. Jjukira, munnange omunafu atali munywevu, tosaana kusigala mu mbeera eno. Tekigenda kukola okuba omuntu ow'ekitalo era omusabiriza gy'oli wekka. Yimirira, weetunuulire, olabe obanga wateekebwawo okuba ng'ekikere wansi w'ekyuma ekirima, ng'otya obulamu bwo okutambula oba okuyimirira. Beera n'endowooza yiyo. Kino si nsonga ya mwoyo yokka, wabula erina okukwatagana n'obusajja obwa bulijjo. Nnandikoze ebintu bingi okusanyusa mikwano gyange; naye okugenda mu muliro okubasanyusa kusinga kye nnandigezezzaako. Kiyinza okuba ekirungi nnyo okukola kino n'ekiri olw'omukwano omulungi; naye tekijja kukola okufiirwa omukwano gwa Katonda olw'okusigala mu nkolagana ennungi n'abantu. “Ekyo nkimanyi,” omuntu bw'agamba, “naye kyokka, wadde nga nkimanyi, sisobola kufuna buvumu. Sisobola kulaga langi zange. Sisobola kunywera.” Kale, naawe nnina ekigambo kye kimu okukuleetera: “Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda.” Singa Peetero yali wano, yandigambye nti, “Mukama Yesu yanfiirira ne mu kiseera we nnali ekitonde ekinafu ennyo nga n'omuwala eyali akuuma omuliro yannyingiza mu kulimba, n'okulayira nti simanyi Mukama.” Yee, Yesu yafiirira abo abaamuleka ne badduka. Nyweza nnyo ku mazima gano--“Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda nga bakyali abanafu.” Guno gwe mulyango gwo ogw'okuva mu buti bwo. Kisseeko mu mwoyo gwo, “Kristo yanfiirira,” era mangu ojja kuba weetegefu okumufiirira. Kikkirize, nti yabonaabona mu kifo kyo, era n'akuwaayo okutangirira okujjuvu, okw'amazima, era okumatiza. Bw'onookkiriza amazima ago, ojja kuwalirizibwa okuwulira nti, “Siyinza kukwatibwa nsonyi olwa Oyo eyanfiirira.” Okukakasibwa okujjuvu nti kino kya mazima kujja kukuwa obuvumu obutatya. Tunuulira abatukuvu mu kiseera eky'okubonaabona. Mu nnaku ez'edda ez'Obukristaayo, endowooza eno ennene ey'okwagala kwa Kristo okusukkiridde bwe kwali kumasamasa mu bugya bwakwo bwonna mu kkanisa, abantu tebaali beetegefu kufa kyokka, wabula baayagala nnyo okubonaabona, era ne beewaayo nga bakumi ku ntebe z'omusango ez'abafuzi, nga bawa obujulizi ku Kristo. Sigamba nti baali bagezi okwegomba okufa okw'obukambwe; naye kikakasa ekigambo kyange, nti okuwulira okwagala kwa Yesu kuyimusa endowooza okusinga okutya kwonna okw'ekyo omuntu ky'ayinza okutukola. Lwaki tekyandikoze ekintu kye kimu mu ggwe? Woowe singa kaakano kyakusikiriza n'okusalawo okw'obuvumu okujja ku ludda lwa Mukama, era okuba omugoberezi we okutuusa ku nkomerero!

Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyambe okutuuka wano olw'okukkiriza Mukama Yesu, era kijja kubeera bulungi!
fields.body_text: WOOWE! SISOBOLA KUKOLA KINTU! OLUVANNYUMA OMUTIMA OGWEERALIIKIRIDDE lwe gumaze okukkiriza enjigiriza ey'okutangirira, ne guyiga amazima amakulu nti obulokozi buva mu kukkiriza Mukama Yesu, emirundi mingi guba gunakuwavu nnyo olw'okuwulira obutasobola kukola kirungi. Bangi bakaaba nti, "Sisobola kukola kintu." Tekiba nsonga gye bawaayo yokka, wabula bakiwulira ng'omugugu ogwa buli lunaku. Bandikikoze singa bandisobodde. Buli omu ayinza okwogera mu bwesimbu nti, "Okwagala kundiko, naye engeri y'okukola kye njagala sigirabako." Okuwulira kuno kulabika ng'okufuula Enjiri yonna nga teraaba na makulu; kubanga emmere egasa ki omuntu alumwa enjala bw'atagituukako? Omugga gw'amazzi ag'obulamu gugasa ki omuntu bw'atagunywa? Tujjukira olugero lw'omusawo n'omwana w'omukazi omwavu. Omusawo omugezi yagamba nnyina nti omwana we ajja kuwona mangu bw'anaajjanjabibwa obulungi, naye kyali kyetaagisa nnyo nti omulenzi we anywenga buli lunaku wayini asinga obulungi, era amale ekiseera mu kifo eky'amazzi ag'eddagala mu Bugirimaani. Kino, eri nnamwandu eyali tasobola na kufuna mmere ya kulya! Kaakano, oluusi kirabika eri omutima ogweeraliikiridde ng'Enjiri entangaavu ey'okugamba nti "Kkiriza obeere mulamu," si nnyangu nnyo bwe kityo; kubanga esaba omwonoonyi omwavu okukola ky'atasobola kukola. Eri oyo azuukuse ddala naye nga tannayigirizibwa bulungi, walabika ng'ekyunga ekibulako; laba obulokozi bwa Yesu buli wali, naye buyinza kutuukibwako butya? Emmeeme terina maanyi, era temanyi kya kukola. Egalamidde ng'eraba ekibuga eky'obuddukiro, naye nga tesobola kuyingira mu mulyango gwakyo. Obutaba na maanyi kuno kwakisibwako mu nteekateeka y'obulokozi? Weewaawo. Omulimu gwa Mukama mutuukirivu. Gutandikira we tuli, era tegutwetaagisa kintu kyonna okugutuukiriza. Omusamaliya omulungi bwe yalaba omutambuze ng'agalamidde ng'afumitiddwa era ng'afu omutwe, teyamugamba kuyimuka kujja gy'ali, kulinnya ku ndogoyi n'agenda mu nnyumba y'abagenyi. Nedda, "yajja we yali," n'amujjanjaba, n'amuwanika ku nsolo n'amutwala mu nnyumba y'abagenyi. Bw'atyo Mukama Yesu bw'atukola mu mbeera yaffe eya wansi era ennaku. Tulabye nti Katonda awa obutuukirivu, nti awa obutuukirivu abatatya Katonda, era nti abawa obutuukirivu ng'ayita mu kukkiriza omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw'omuwendo; kaakano tulina okulaba embeera abatatya Katonda bano gye baba bali Yesu ng'akola obulokozi bwabwe. Abantu bangi abazuukuse tebeeraliikirira bibi byabwe byokka, wabula n'obunafu bwabwe mu mpisa. Tebalina maanyi ga kuvaamu mu bitosi mwe bagudde, wadde okwewala okuddamu okugwamu mu nnaku ez'omu maaso. Tebakungubagira ku kye bakoze kyokka, wabula ne ku kye batasobola kukola. Beewulira nga tebalina maanyi, nga tebalina buyambi, era nga bafu mu mwoyo. Kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekitasaana okugamba nti beewulira nga bafu, kyokka bwe kiri bwe kityo. Mu ndowooza yaabwe, tebasobola kukola kirungi kyonna. Tebasobola kutambula luguudo oluggya mu ggulu, kubanga amagumba gaabwe gamenyese. "Tewali n'omu ku basajja ab'amaanyi eyalaba emikono gye;" mu butuufu, "tebalina maanyi." Eky'essanyu, kyawandiikibwa, ng'okutendereza okwagala kwa Katonda gye tuli: Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda (Abaruumi 5:6). Wano tulaba obutaba na buyambi obumanyiddwa nga buyambibwa--nga buyambibwa olw'okweyingiza kwa Mukama Yesu. Obutaba na buyambi bwaffe bwa kkomo. Tekyawandiikibwa nti, "Bwe twali abanafu katono Kristo yatufiirira"; oba, "Bwe twali n'amaanyi matono"; wabula okunnyonnyola kujjuvu era tekuliiko kkomo; "Bwe twali tukyali abanafu." Twali tetulina maanyi n'akatono agandiyambye mu bulokozi bwaffe; ebigambo bya Mukama waffe byali bya mazima ddala, "Awatali nze temuyinza kukola kintu." Nnyinza okweyongerayo okusinga ekyawandiikibwa, ne mbajjukiza okwagala okungi Mukama kwe yatwagala nakwo, "ne bwe twali abafu olw'ebyonoono n'ebibi." Okuba omufu kusinga n'okuba nga tolina maanyi. Ekintu ekimu omwonoonyi omwavu atalina maanyi ky'alina okussaako omwoyo gwe, n'akinyweza, ng'omusingi gwe ogumu ogw'essuubi, ye ndagaano ya Katonda nti "mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Kkiriza kino, n'obutasobola bwonna bujja kubula. Nga bwe kigero ku Midas nti buli kye yakwatako yakifuula zaabu, bwe kityo bwe kiri ku kukkiriza nti buli kye kukwatako kukifuula kirungi. Byetaago byaffe n'obunafu bwaffe bifuuka mikisa okukkiriza bwe kubikwatako. Katuzimbe ku ngeri ezimu ez'obutaba na maanyi buno. Okusooka, omuntu omu anaayogera nti, "Ssebo, sirabika nga nnina amaanyi ga kukungaanya birowoozo byange, ne mbinyweza ku nsonga zino enzito ezikwata ku bulokozi bwange; n'okusaba okumpi kunfuukira kunene nnyo. Kiri bwe kityo, oboolyawo, olw'obunafu obw'obuzaaliranwa, ekitundu kimu olw'okweyonoona nga nneenyigidde mu bwenzi, ate n'ekitundu olw'okweeraliikirira eby'ensi, ne siba na busobozi bw'ebirowoozo ebya waggulu ebyetaagisa ng'emmeeme tennalokolebwa." Eno ngeri nnene nnyo ey'obunafu obw'ekibi. Wuliriza kino! Toliiko maanyi ku nsonga eno; era waliwo bangi abali nga ggwe. Tebandisobodde kugoberera lunyiriri lwa birowoozo olutabalako wadde okuwonya obulamu bwabwe. Abasajja n'abakazi bangi abaavu tebamanyi kusoma era tebayigirizibwa, era bano bandisanze okulowooza okw'amaanyi nga mulimu muzito nnyo. Abalala baba bangu era ba butafaayo mu buzaaliranwa, ne batasobola kugoberera nkola nnene ey'empaka n'okulowooza, nga bwe batayinza kubuuka. Tebandituuse ku kumanya ekyama kyonna eky'amaanyi ne bwe bandimazeeko obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Noolwekyo, tosaana kuggwaamu ssuubi: ekyetaagisa mu bulokozi si kulowooza okutasala, wabula okwesiga Yesu okwangu. Nyweza ku kintu kino ekimu-- "Mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Amazima gano tegaakwetaagise kunoonyereza kwa maanyi wadde okulowooza okw'amaanyi, oba empaka ezikakasa. Kiri wali: "Mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Ssaako omwoyo gwo ku ekyo, era owummulire eyo. Amazima gano agamu amakulu, ag'ekisa, ag'ekitiibwa gabeere mu mwoyo gwo okutuusa lwe ganaawunyisa ebirowoozo byo byonna akaloosa akalungi, ne gakusanyusa wadde nga toliiko maanyi, ng'olaba nga Mukama Yesu afuuse amaanyi go n'oluyimba lwo, weewaawo, afuuse obulokozi bwo. Ng'Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba, kya mazima ekyabikkulwa, nti mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda nga bakyali abanafu. Oyinza okuba nga owulidde ebigambo bino emirundi ebikumi, kyokka nga tewali we wategeeredde makulu gaabyo. Waliwo akaloosa akasanyusa akabyo, si bwe kiri? Yesu teyafiirira butuukirivu bwaffe, wabula yafiirira ebibi byaffe. Teyajja kutulokola lwa kubanga twali tusaanira okulokolebwa, wabula lwa kubanga twali tetugasa ku bwonna, nga tuzikiridde, era nga twonoonese. Teyajja ku nsi lwa nsonga yonna eyali mu ffe, wabula lwa nsonga zokka ze yaggya mu buziba bw'okwagala kwe okutukuvu. Mu kiseera ekituufu yafiirira abo b'ayogerako, si nga abatya Katonda, wabula nga abatatya Katonda, ng'abawa erinnya erisinga obw'obutasuubira bw'ayinza okulonda. Bw'oba n'omutwe mutono, era gunyweze ku mazima gano, agagera ku busobozi obusinga obutono, era agasobola okusanyusa omutima ogusinga okuzitowa. Ekigambo kino kibeere wansi w'olulimi lwo ng'akantu akawoomerera, okutuusa lwe kanaasaanuukira mu mutima gwo ne kawoomya ebirowoozo byo byonna; olwo tekyakuluma wadde ebirowoozo ebyo nga bisaasaanye ng'ebikoola ebiwuguma mu mpewo. Abantu abatalabikanga mu by'ensayansi, wadde okulaga akatono ak'obusobozi obw'omutwe, naye baasobola bulungi okukkiriza enjigiriza y'omusaalaba, ne balokolebwa mu yo. Lwaki ggwe teyandikoze bwe kityo? Mpulira omulala ng'akaaba nti, "Woowe, ssebo obutaba na maanyi bwange businga kubeera mu kino, nti sisobola kwenenya kumala!" Endowooza ey'ekyewuunyo abantu gye balina ku kye kwenenya kwe! Bangi balowooza nti amaziga mangi ge gasaana okukulukuta, n'okusinda okungi kwe kusaana okuwulirwa, n'obutasuubira obungi bwe busaana okugumiikirizibwa. Endowooza eno etaliimu makulu eva wa? Obutakkiriza n'obutasuubira bibi, era noolwekyo sirengera engeri gye biyinza okubeeramu ebitundu ebikola okwenenya okukkirizibwa; kyokka waliwo bangi ababiraba ng'ebitundu ebyetaagisa eby'obulamu bw'Omukristaayo ow'amazima. Bali mu nsobi nnene. Naye kyokka, mmanyi kye bategeeza, kubanga mu nnaku z'ekizikiza kyange nnali njogera bwe ntyo. Nnayagala okwenenya, naye nnalowooza nti sisobola kukikola, kyokka ekiseera kyonna nga nnenenya. Wadde nga kiwulikika ng'eky'ekyewuunyo, nnawulira nga sisobola kuwulira. Nnayinganga mu nsonda ne nkaaba, kubanga nnali sisobola kukaaba; era nnagwa mu nnaku enkambwe kubanga nnali sisobola kunakuwalira kibi. Kizibu ki kino kyonna nga mu mbeera yaffe ey'obutakkiriza tutandika okusalira embeera yaffe omusango! Kiri ng'omuzibe amaaso ng'atunuulira amaaso ge ye. Omutima gwange gwasaanuuka munda yange olw'okutya, kubanga nnalowooza nti omutima gwange mukakanyavu ng'ejjinja ery'adamanti. Omutima gwange gwamenyeka olw'okulowooza nti teguumenyeke. Kaakano nsobola okulaba nti nnali ndaga ekintu kyennyini kye nnalowooza nti sirina; naye mu kiseera ekyo nnali simanyi we nnali. Singa nnasobola okuyamba abalala okuyingira mu kitangaala kye nsanyukira kaakano! Nnandyagadde okwogera ekigambo ekiyinza okukendeeza ku budde bw'okubuluŋŋanya kwabwe. Nnandyogedde ebigambo bitono ebyeyoleka, ne nsaba "Omubudaabudi" abisseeko ku mutima. Jjukira nti omuntu eyeenenya mu mazima taamatire ku kwenenya kwe ye. Tetusobola kwenenya bulungi ddala nga bwe tutasobola kubeera balamu bulungi ddala. Ne bwe gaba amaziga gaffe amayonjo gatya, gajja kubeeramu obucaafu obumu: wajja kubaawo ekintu eky'okwenenyezaako ne mu kwenenya kwaffe okusinga obulungi. Naye wuliriza! Okwenenya kwe kukyusa endowooza yo ku kibi, ne ku Kristo, ne ku bintu byonna ebikulu ebya Katonda. Mu kino mulimu ennaku; naye ekikulu kwe kukyusa omutima okuva mu kibi okudda eri Kristo. Bwe wabaawo okukyuka kuno, oba olina obukulu bw'okwenenya okw'amazima, wadde nga tewali kutya wadde butasuubira ebyali biteeka ekisiikirize kyabyo ku ndowooza yo. Bw'oba nga tosobola kwenenya nga bw'oyagala, kijja kukuyamba nnyo okukikola bw'onookkiririza ddala nti "mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Kirowoozeeko emirundi n'emirundi. Oyinza otya okusigala ng'olina omutima omukakanyavu ng'omanyi nti olw'okwagala okusingayo "Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda"? Ka nkusendasende okwewuunuza bw'oti: Newankubadde ndi mutatya Katonda, era wadde omutima guno ogw'ekyuma teguuwuluke, wadde nga nneekuba mu kifuba awatali kugasa, kyokka yafiirira abali nga nze, kubanga yafiirira abatatya Katonda. Woowe singa nnakkiriza kino ne mpulira amaanyi gaakyo ku mutima gwange ogukaluubidde! Sangula buli ndowooza endala mu mwoyo gwo, otuule essaawa ku ssaawa, ofumiitirize nnyo ku kwolesebwa kuno okumu okumasamasa okw'okwagala okutasaanidwa, okutasuubirwa, okutalina kifaananyi, "Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Soma n'obwegendereza ebyafaayo by'okufa kwa Mukama, nga bw'obisanga mu bawandiisi b'Enjiri abana. Bwe wabaawo ekiyinza okusaanuusa omutima gwo omukakanyavu, kijja kuba kwe kulaba okubonaabona kwa Yesu, n'okulowooza nti yabonaabona bino byonna ku lw'abalabe be. Ayi Yesu! amaziga ge nkulukusa gawooma, Nga nfukamidde ku bigere byo, Ne ntunuulira omutwe gwo ogufumitiddwa, oguzirika, N'awulira ennaku zo zonna. Omutima gwange gusaanuuka okukulaba ng'ovaamu omusaayi, Omutima guno ogwali omukakanyavu edda; Nkuwulira ng'osabira abazza omusango, N'ennaku zeeyongera okukulukuta. Wafiirira aboonoonyi, Nange omwonoonyi nnyimiridde: Nkakasibwa eriiso lyo eriggwaamu obulamu, Nzitiddwa omukono gwo ogwafumitibwa. Mazima ddala omusaalaba gwe muggo ogw'ebyamagero ogusobola okuggya amazzi mu lwazi. Bw'ategeera amakulu amajjuvu ag'ekiweebwayo kya Yesu eky'obwakatonda, olina okwenenya olw'okuba nga wali oyolekedde Oyo ajjudde okwagala. Kyawandiikibwa nti, "Balitunuulira oyo gwe baafumita, ne bamukungubagira ng'omuntu bw'akungubagira omwana we omu yekka, era balimunakuwalira ng'omuntu anakuwalira omwana we omubereberye." Okwenenya tekujja kukusobozesa kulaba Kristo; naye okulaba Kristo kujja kukuwa okwenenya. Toyinza kukola Kristo ng'omuggya mu kwenenya kwo, naye olina okunoonya okwenenya okuva eri Kristo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng'atukyusa okudda eri Kristo, atukyusa okuva mu kibi. Kale, tunula okuva ku kivaamu okudda ku nsibuko, okuva ku kwenenya kwo okudda eri Mukama Yesu, agulumizibbwa waggulu okuwa okwenenya. Mpulidde omulala ng'agamba nti, "Mbonyaabonyezebwa ebirowoozo ebitiisa. Buli gye ŋŋenda, okuvvoola kunneeyingiza. Emirundi mingi nga nkola omulimu gwange, endowooza embi ennyo eneekakaako, era ne ku kitanda kyange nzuukuka mu tulo olw'okwasomooza kw'oyo omubi. Sisobola kuva mu kukemebwa kuno okw'entiisa." Munnange, mmanyi kye otegeeza, kubanga nange nawambibwa omusege guno. Omuntu ayinza okusuubira okulwanyisa ekibinja ky'ensowera n'ekitala nga bw'ayinza okufuga ebirowoozo bye Setaani bw'abisindika. Emmeeme eyavu ekemebwa, elumbibwa endowooza za Setaani, eri ng'omutambuze gwe nnasoma, eyajjirwa ekibinja ky'enjuki ezaali zisunguwadde ku mutwe ne ku matu ne ku mubiri gwe gwonna. Teyasobola kuziziyiza wadde okuzidduka. Zaamulumira wonna era zaayagala okumutta. Sewuunya bw'owulira nti toliiko maanyi ga kuziyiza birowoozo bino ebibi era eby'ekivve Setaani by'afuka mu mwoyo gwo; naye kyokka nnandikujjukiza Ekyawandiikibwa ekiri mu maaso gaffe--"Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Yesu yamanya we twali era we twandibadde; yalaba nga tetusobola kuwangula omulangira ow'obuyinza obw'omu mpewo; yamanya nga twandibonyeebonyezebbwa nnyo naye; naye ne mu kiseera ekyo, bwe yatulaba nga tuli mu mbeera eyo, Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda. Ssuula essikiro ly'okukkiriza kwo ku kino. Setaani yennyini tasobola kukugamba nti si mutatya Katonda; kale kkiriza nti Yesu yafiirira n'abali nga ggwe. Jjukira engeri Martin Luther gye yasalamu omutwe gwa Setaani n'ekitala kye ye. "Woowe," Setaani bwe yagamba Martin Luther, "oli mwonoonyi." "Yee," n'agamba, "Kristo yafa okulokola aboonoonyi." Bw'atyo n'amukuba n'ekitala kye ye. Weekweke mu buddukiro buno, era osigale omwo: "Mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Bw'onoonyweera ku mazima ago, ebirowoozo byo eby'okuvvoola by'otoliiko maanyi ga kugoba bijja kwegendera byokka; kubanga Setaani ajja kulaba nti tewali ky'agenderera bw'akutawaanya nabyo. Ebirowoozo bino, bw'obikyawa, si byo, wabula kuteeka kwa Setaani, ye gw'avunaanibwa, so si ggwe. Bw'obilwanyisa, tebiba byo, nga bwe bitali byo okukolima n'obulimba bw'abeeyongobezi mu luguudo. Setaani ayita mu birowoozo bino okukusindika mu butasuubira, oba okumpi kukuziyiza okwesiga Yesu. Omukazi omulwadde omwavu teyasobola kutuuka ku Yesu olw'ekibiina, era naawe oli mu mbeera y'emu, olw'okunyigirizibwa n'ekibiina ky'ebirowoozo bino ebitiisa. Kyokka, yagolola olugalo lwe, n'akwata ku mukugiro gw'ekyambalo kya Mukama, n'awonyezebwa. Kola bwe kityo naawe. Yesu yafiirira abo abazza omusango olw'"ebibi n'okuvvoola kwonna," era noolwekyo nkakasa nti tajja kugaana abo abawambiddwa ebirowoozo ebibi awatali kwagala kwabwe. Weesuule ku ye, awamu n'ebirowoozo byo byonna, olabe obanga si wa maanyi kulokola. Asobola okusirisa okwasomooza kw'omubi okutiisa okwo, oba asobola okukusobozesa okubiraba mu kitangaala kyabyo eky'amazima, oleme okutawaanyizibwa nabyo. Mu ngeri ye ye asobola era ajja kukulokola, era ku nkomerero akuwe emirembe emituukirivu. Mwesige yekka ku kino ne ku buli kintu ekirala. Kya nnaku era kya kubuluŋŋanya engeri eyo ey'obutasobola eri mu kirowoozo eky'obutaba na buyinza bwa kukkiriza. Tetuli bagenyi eri okukaaba: Woowe singa nnakkiriza, Olwo byonna byandyanguyiddwa; Nnaagala, naye sisobola; Mukama, mmalako, Obuyambi bwange buteekwa okuva gy'oli. Bangi basigala mu kizikiza okumala emyaka mingi kubanga tebalina maanyi, nga bwe bagamba, ga kukola ekyo ekiri okuleka amaanyi gonna n'okwewummuza mu maanyi g'omulala, ye Mukama Yesu. Mazima ddala, kya kyewuunyo nnyo, ensonga eno yonna ey'okukkiriza; kubanga abantu tebafuna buyambi bungi olw'okugezaako okukkiriza. Okukkiriza tekuva mu kugezaako. Singa omuntu yayogera ekigambo eky'ekintu ekibaddewo leero, sandimugambye nti nnaagezaako okumukkiriza. Singa nnakkiririza mu mazima g'omuntu eyantegeeza ekyo era n'agamba nti yakiraba, nnandikkirizza ekigambo mangu. Singa nnali simulaba ng'omuntu ow'amazima, mazima nnandimutakkirizza; naye tewandibadde kugezaako mu nsonga eyo. Kaakano, Katonda bw'alangirira nti waliwo obulokozi mu Kristo Yesu, nteekwa oba okumukkiriza mangu, oba okumufuula mulimba. Mazima ddala tojja kubuusabuusa ku luguudo oluluŋŋamu mu nsonga eno. Obujulizi bwa Katonda buteekwa okuba obwa mazima, era tuwaliriziddwa okukkiriza Yesu mangu. Naye oboolyawo obadde ogezaako okukkiriza ennyo. Kaakano teweeteeka ku bintu bikulu. Matira okuba n'okukkiriza okusobola okukwata mu mukono gwakwo amazima gano agamu, "Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lw'abantu nga bakyali tebamukkiriza, era nga tebasobola kumukkiriza. Yafiirira abantu, si nga abakkiriza, wabula nga aboonoonyi. Yajja okufuula aboonoonyi bano abakkiriza n'abatukuvu; naye bwe yabafiirira yabalaba nga tebalina maanyi n'akatono. Bw'onyweera ku mazima nti Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda, era n'okukkiriza, okukkiriza kwo kujja kukulokola, era oyinza okugenda mirembe. Bw'onooteeka emmeeme yo mu mikono gya Yesu, eyafiirira abatatya Katonda, wadde nga tosobola kukkiriza bintu byonna, wadde okusiimuula ensozi, wadde okukola omulimu omulala gwonna ogw'ekyewuunyo, kyokka olokoseddwa. Si kukkiriza kunene, wabula okukkiriza okw'amazima, kwe kulokola; era obulokozi tebuli mu kukkiriza, wabula mu Kristo okukkiriza mwe kwesiga. Okukkiriza okwenkana n'empeke ya kaamwanyi kujja kuleeta obulokozi. Si kigero ky'okukkiriza, wabula obwesimbu bw'okukkiriza, kye kintu ekisaana okulowoozebwako. Mazima ddala omuntu asobola okukkiriza ky'amanyi nti kya mazima; era nga bw'omanyi nti Yesu wa mazima, ggwe, munnange, osobola okumukkiriza. Omusaalaba, gwe kigendererwa ky'okukkiriza, era gwe nsibuko yaakwo, olw'amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tuula otunuulire Omulokozi ng'afa okutuusa okukkiriza lwe kunaavaayo lwokka mu mutima gwo. Tewali kifo kiri nga Kalvary ku kutondawo obwesige. Empewo ey'olusozi olwo olutukuvu ereeta obulamu eri okukkiriza okukankana. Bangi abaabeera eyo baagamba nti: Nga nkutunuulira, ng'ofumitiddwa, ng'onakuwadde, Nga tokyassa ku muti omukolimire, Mukama, mpulira omutima gwange nga gukkiriza Nti wabonaabona bw'otyo ku lwange. "Woowe!" omulala akaaba, "obutaba na maanyi bwange buli mu ludda luno, nti sisobola kuleka kibi kyange, era mmanyi nti sisobola kugenda mu ggulu nga neetisse ekibi kyange." Nsanyuka nti okimanyi, kubanga kya mazima ddala. Oteekwa okwawukana ku kibi kyo, oba toyinza kufumbirwa Kristo. Jjukira ekibuuzo ekyayingira mu birowoozo bya Bunyan omuvubuka bwe yali mu mizannyo gye ku ttale ku Ssande: "Onooba n'ebibi byo n'ogenda mu muliro, oba onooleka ebibi byo n'ogenda mu ggulu?" Ekyo kyamuyimiriza ddala. Ekyo kye kibuuzo buli muntu ky'anaateekwa okuddamu: kubanga tewali kweyongera mu kibi ng'ogenda mu ggulu. Ekyo tekiyinza kubaawo. Oteekwa okuleka ekibi oba okuleka essuubi. Oddamu nti, "Yee, njagala bulungi. Okwagala kundiko, naye engeri y'okukola kye njagala sigirabako. Ekibi kimfuga, era siriiko maanyi." Jjangu, kale, bw'oba nga toliiko maanyi, ekigambo kino kikyali kya mazima, "Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Okyasobola okukikkiriza? Ne bwe biba ebintu ebirala birabika ng'ebikuwakanya, onookikkiriza? Katonda akigambye, era kya mazima; noolwekyo, kinyweze ng'okufa, kubanga essuubi lyo lyokka liri omwo. Kkiriza kino era wesige Yesu, era mangu ojja kufuna amaanyi ge onoosaanyaawo ekibi kyo; naye awatali ye, omuntu ow'amaanyi eyeewanvuya ajja kukukwata emirembe gyonna ng'omuddu we omusibe. Nze kennyini, sandita nnasobola kuwangula bibi byange. Nnagezaako ne nnema. Emize gyange emibi gyali mingi nnyo okunsinga, okutuusa, mu kukkiriza nti Kristo yanfiirira, bwe nnasuula emmeeme yange erina omusango ku ye, olwo ne mfuna omusingi ogugumye kwe nnawangulira nze omwonoonyi. Enjigiriza y'omusaalaba eyinza okukozesebwa okutta ekibi, nga n'abalwanyi ab'edda bwe baakozesa ebitala byabwe ebinene eby'emikono ebiri, ne batemako abalabe baabwe buli lwe baakuba. Tewali kiri ng'okukkiriza mu Mukwano gw'omwonoonyi: kuwangula obubi bwonna. Kristo bw'aba yanfiirira, nga ndi mutatya Katonda, nga siriiko maanyi, kale siyinza kweyongera kubeera mu kibi, wabula nteekwa okwezuukusa okwagala n'okuweereza Oyo eyannunula. Siyinza kukolako na bubi obwatta Mukwano gwange omulungi. Nteekwa okuba omutukuvu ku lulwe. Nnyinza ntya okubeera mu kibi ng'afudde okundokola mu kyo? Laba obuyambi obulungi nnyo buno bwe buli gy'oli atalina maanyi, okumanya n'okukkiriza nti mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda ng'abali nga ggwe. Otegedde endowooza? Mu ngeri emu, kizibu nnyo eri ebirowoozo byaffe ebikwafuwalidde, ebiriimu obukyayi, era ebitakkiriza okulaba obukulu bw'Enjiri. Oluusi nnalowooza, nga mmaze okubuulira, nti ntese Enjiri bulungi nnyo, nti n'ennyindo ku maaso g'omuntu teyandibadde nnyangu kulaba okusingawo; kyokka ntegeera nti n'abawuliriza abagezi baalemwa okutegeera amakulu ga "Muntunuulire mulokolebwe." Abakyuse batera okugamba nti tebaamanya Enjiri okutuusa ku lunaku luli n'oluli; kyokka baali bagiwulidde okumala emyaka. Enjiri temanyiddwa, si lwa kubulwa nnyonnyola, wabula lwa butabaawo kwabikkulirwa kwa muntu ye kinnoomu. Kuno Omwoyo Omutukuvu yeeteeseteese okukuwa, era ajja kukuwa abo abamusaba. Kyokka bwe kuweebwa, omugatte gw'amazima agabikkulwa gonna gali mu bigambo bino: "Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Mpulira omulala nga yeekaabya bw'ati: "Woowe, ssebo, obunafu bwange buli mu kino, nti sirabika nga nsigala nga ndi mu ndowooza emu okumala ebbanga! Mpulira ekigambo ku Ssande, ne nkwatibwako; naye mu wiiki nsisinkana munnange omubi, n'enneewulira zange ennungi zonna ne ziggwaawo. Bakozi bannange tebalina kye bakkiriza, era boogera ebintu ebibi ennyo, ne sitegeera ngeri ya kubaddamu, ne neesanga nga nziduka." Mmumanyi bulungi ono Omugonvu Omuteefu, era mmukankanira; naye mu kiseera kye kimu, bw'aba ng'ali mwesimbu ddala, obunafu bwe busobola okuyambibwa ekisa kya Katonda. Omwoyo Omutukuvu asobola okugoba omwoyo omubi ogw'okutya omuntu. Asobola okufuula omuti omuzira. Jjukira, munnange omunafu atali munywevu, tosaana kusigala mu mbeera eno. Tekigenda kukola okuba omuntu ow'ekitalo era omusabiriza gy'oli wekka. Yimirira, weetunuulire, olabe obanga wateekebwawo okuba ng'ekikere wansi w'ekyuma ekirima, ng'otya obulamu bwo okutambula oba okuyimirira. Beera n'endowooza yiyo. Kino si nsonga ya mwoyo yokka, wabula erina okukwatagana n'obusajja obwa bulijjo. Nnandikoze ebintu bingi okusanyusa mikwano gyange; naye okugenda mu muliro okubasanyusa kusinga kye nnandigezezzaako. Kiyinza okuba ekirungi nnyo okukola kino n'ekiri olw'omukwano omulungi; naye tekijja kukola okufiirwa omukwano gwa Katonda olw'okusigala mu nkolagana ennungi n'abantu. "Ekyo nkimanyi," omuntu bw'agamba, "naye kyokka, wadde nga nkimanyi, sisobola kufuna buvumu. Sisobola kulaga langi zange. Sisobola kunywera." Kale, naawe nnina ekigambo kye kimu okukuleetera: "Bwe twali tukyali abanafu, mu kiseera ekituufu Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda." Singa Peetero yali wano, yandigambye nti, "Mukama Yesu yanfiirira ne mu kiseera we nnali ekitonde ekinafu ennyo nga n'omuwala eyali akuuma omuliro yannyingiza mu kulimba, n'okulayira nti simanyi Mukama." Yee, Yesu yafiirira abo abaamuleka ne badduka. Nyweza nnyo ku mazima gano--"Kristo yafiirira abatatya Katonda nga bakyali abanafu." Guno gwe mulyango gwo ogw'okuva mu buti bwo. Kisseeko mu mwoyo gwo, "Kristo yanfiirira," era mangu ojja kuba weetegefu okumufiirira. Kikkirize, nti yabonaabona mu kifo kyo, era n'akuwaayo okutangirira okujjuvu, okw'amazima, era okumatiza. Bw'onookkiriza amazima ago, ojja kuwalirizibwa okuwulira nti, "Siyinza kukwatibwa nsonyi olwa Oyo eyanfiirira." Okukakasibwa okujjuvu nti kino kya mazima kujja kukuwa obuvumu obutatya. Tunuulira abatukuvu mu kiseera eky'okubonaabona. Mu nnaku ez'edda ez'Obukristaayo, endowooza eno ennene ey'okwagala kwa Kristo okusukkiridde bwe kwali kumasamasa mu bugya bwakwo bwonna mu kkanisa, abantu tebaali beetegefu kufa kyokka, wabula baayagala nnyo okubonaabona, era ne beewaayo nga bakumi ku ntebe z'omusango ez'abafuzi, nga bawa obujulizi ku Kristo. Sigamba nti baali bagezi okwegomba okufa okw'obukambwe; naye kikakasa ekigambo kyange, nti okuwulira okwagala kwa Yesu kuyimusa endowooza okusinga okutya kwonna okw'ekyo omuntu ky'ayinza okutukola. Lwaki tekyandikoze ekintu kye kimu mu ggwe? Woowe singa kaakano kyakusikiriza n'okusalawo okw'obuvumu okujja ku ludda lwa Mukama, era okuba omugoberezi we okutuusa ku nkomerero! Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyambe okutuuka wano olw'okukkiriza Mukama Yesu, era kijja kubeera bulungi!

fields.title: Okweyongera kw'Okukkiriza
fields.body_html:
OKWEYONGERA KW'OKUKKIRIZA

TUYINZA TUTYA OKUFUNA okweyongera kw'okukkiriza? Kino kibuuzo eky'amaanyi eri bangi. Bagamba nti baagala okukkiriza, naye tebasobola. Waliwo ebigambo bingi ebitaliimu makulu ebyogerwa ku nsonga eno. Ka tubeere ab'amagezi amakkalu mu ngeri gye tugigyamu. Amagezi amakkalu geetaagisa mu ddiini nga bwe geetaagisa mu buli kifo ekirala. “Nkole ki ndyoke nkkirize?” Omuntu eyabuuzibwa engeri esinga obulungi ey'okukola ekintu ekimu ekyangu, yaddamu nti engeri esinga obulungi okukikola kwe kukikola mangwago. Tufiirwa obudde nga tuwakana ku ngeri z'okukola nga ekikolwa kyennyini kyangu. Ekkubo erisinga obumpi ery'okukkiriza kwe kukkiriza. Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'akufudde ow'amazima, ojja kukkiriza amangu ddala nga amazima gakuteekeddwa mu maaso. Ojja kugakkiriza kubanga ga mazima. Ekiragiro ky'enjiri kitegeerekeka bulungi; “Kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo, naawe olirokolebwa.” Tekigasa kwewala kino n'ebibuuzo n'okuwakanya. Ekiragiro kya lwatu; ka kigonderwe.

Naye ate, bw'oba n'obuzibu, kitwale mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba. Tegeeza Kitaawe omukulu ekituufu ekikutabula, era omwegayirire ku bw'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu okugonjoola ekibuuzo. Bwe ssobola kukkiriza kigambo ekiri mu kitabo, nsanyuka okubuuza omuwandiisi ky'ategeeza nakyo; era bw'aba muntu wa mazima, okunnyonnyola kwe kunnematiza; okusinga nnyo, okunnyonnyola kwa Katonda ku bifo ebizibu eby'Ebyawandiikibwa kuliisiza omutima gw'oyo anoonya n'amazima. Mukama ayagala okwemanyisa; genda gy'ali olabe oba si bwe kiri. Yingira mangu mu kasenge ko, okaabe nti, “Ayi Omwoyo Omutukuvu, nkulembere mu mazima! Kye simanyi, kinjigirize.”

Ate era, okukkiriza bwe kulabika nga kuzibu, kiyinzika nti Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu anaakusobozesa okukkiriza bw'onoowuliranga emirundi mingi era n'omwoyo gwo gwonna ekyo ky'olagiddwa okukkiriza. Tukkiriza ebintu bingi kubanga tubiwulidde emirundi mingi. Tokiraba mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, nti bw'owulira ekintu emirundi ataano mu lunaku, oluvannyuma osituka n'okikkiriza? Abantu abamu batuuse okukkiriza ebigambo ebitali bya kusuubirwa n'olw'engeri eno, kyenva sewuunya nti Omwoyo omulungi bulijjo awa omukisa engeri ey'okuwulira amazima emirundi mingi, era agikozesa okukola okukkiriza ku ekyo ekiteekwa okukkirizibwa. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Okukkiriza kuva mu kuwulira”; kale wuliranga emirundi mingi. Bwe mpuliriza enjiri n'obwegendereza n'omwoyo gwange gwonna, olumu ku nnaku zino nzija kwezuula nga nkkiriza kye mpulira, olw'omulimu omulungi ogw'Omwoyo wa Katonda mu birowoozo byange. Kyokka weegendereze owulire enjiri, era tosaasaanya birowoozo byo n'okuwulira oba okusoma ekyo ekyakolebwa okukunyeenyeza mu kukkiriza.

Naye, ekyo bwe kirabika ng'okubuulirira okutali kwa maanyi, nnyongerako kino, lowooza ku bujulirwa bw'abalala. Abasamaliya baakkiriza olw'ekyo omukazi kye yababuulira ku Yesu. Ebintu bingi bye tukkiriza biva mu bujulirwa bw'abalala. Nkkiriza nti waliwo ensi eyitibwa Japani; sigirabangako, naye nkkiriza nti ekifo ekyo kiriwo kubanga abalala baagendayo. Nkkiriza nti nzija kufa; sifangako, naye bangi nnyo be nnali mmanyi baafa, kyenva nkakasa nti nange nzija kufa. Obujulirwa bw'abangi bunkakasa ekituufu ekyo. Kale, wuliriza abo abakubuulira engeri gye baalokolerwamu, engeri gye baasonyiyibwamu, engeri empisa zaabwe gye zaakyusibwamu. Bw'onoonoonya ensonga eno ojja kuzuula nti waliwo omuntu ali nga ggwe eyalokolebwa. Bw'oba nga wali mubbi, ojja kuzuula nti omubbi yasanyuka okunaaza ekibi kye mu nzizi y'omusaayi gwa Kristo. Bw'oba, mu bunaku, nga wali mwenzi, ojja kuzuula nti abasajja n'abakazi abaagwa mu kkubo eryo baanaazibwa ne bakyusibwa. Bw'oba mu kunakuwala, weetaaga kwegatta ku bantu ba Katonda, obuuze katono, ojja kuvumbula nti abamu ku batukuvu nabo baali mu kunakuwala okwenkanako ebiseera ebimu, era bajja kusanyuka okukubuulira engeri Mukama gye yabawonyaamu. Bw'onoowuliriza omu ku omu ku abo abagezesezza ekigambo kya Katonda, ne bakikakasa, Omwoyo wa Katonda ajja kukuluŋŋamya okukkiriza. Towuliranga ku Muwafirika eyategeezebwa omuweereza wa Katonda nti amazzi oluusi gakaluba nnyo omuntu n'ayinza okugatambulirako? Yagamba nti yakkiriza ebintu bingi omuweereza bye yamubuulira; naye ekyo teyandikikkirizza n'akatono. Bwe yajja mu Bungereza, lwali lunaku olw'obutiti n'alaba omugga nga gukutte, naye teyagenda kugutambulirako. Yamanya nti gwali mugga muwanvu, era yakakasa nti yandizikiridde bwe yandigenzeko. Teyayinza kusendebwa kutambula ku mazzi agakutte okutuusa mikwano gye n'abalala bangi bwe baagatambulirako; olwo n'akkirizibwa, ne yeesiga awo abalala we baali batambulidde awatali kabi. Bw'otyo, bw'onoolaba abalala nga bakkiriza Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda, n'olaba essanyu n'emirembe byabwe, naawe ojja kutwalibwa mpola mpola okukkiriza. Obumanyirivu bw'abalala y'emu ku ngeri za Katonda ez'okutuyamba okukkiriza. Oteekwa oba okukkiriza Yesu oba okufa; tewali ssuubi lirala eri ggwe wabula mu ye.

Enteekateeka esinga obulungi y'eno--tegeera obuyinza obw'olagirwako okukkiriza, era kino kijja kukuyamba nnyo eri okukkiriza. Obuyinza si bwange, kubanga wandisobodde okubugaana. Naye olagirwa okukkiriza ku buyinza bwa Katonda yennyini. Akulagira okukkiriza Yesu Kristo, era toteekwa kugaana kugondera Omutonzi wo. Omukulu w'abakozi ab'ekkolero erimu yali awulidde enjiri emirundi mingi, naye yali atawaanyizibwa okutya nti ayinza obutajja eri Kristo. Mukama we omulungi lumu n'aweereza kaadi mu kkolero--“Jjangu mu nnyumba yange amangu ddala ng'omulimu guweddeko.” Omukulu w'abakozi n'ajja ku luggi lwa mukama we, mukama we n'afuluma, n'ayogera n'obukambwe obutono, “Oyagala ki, Yokaana, okuntawaanya mu kiseera kino? Omulimu guweddeko, olina buyinza ki okuba wano?” “Ssebo,” n'addamu, “nnafunye kaadi okuva gy'oli nga egamba nti njije ng'omulimu guweddeko.” “Otegeeza nti olwokubanga ofunye kaadi okuva gy'ndi noolwekyo osaana okwambuka mu nnyumba yange n'ompita ebiseera by'emirimu nga biweddeko?” “Kale, Ssebo,” omukulu w'abakozi n'addamu, “sikutegeera, naye kirabika gye ndi nti, olwokubanga wantumidde, nnalina obuyinza okujja.” “Yingira, Yokaana,” mukama we n'agamba, “nnina obubaka obulala bwe njagala okukusomera,” n'atuula n'asoma ebigambo bino: “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza.” “Olowooza nti oluvannyuma lw'obubaka nga buno okuva eri Kristo oyinza okuba nga okyamye okujja gy'ali?” Omuntu omunaku n'akiraba amangu ddala, n'akkiriza Mukama Yesu okutuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo, kubanga yategeera nti yalina obuyinza obulungi n'obukakafu okukkiriza. Naawe bw'otyo, ggwe omwoyo omunaku! Olina obuyinza obulungi okujja eri Kristo, kubanga Mukama yennyini akulagira okumwesiga.

Ekyo bwe kitakuzaaliramu kukkiriza, lowooza ku ekyo ky'oteekwa okukkiriza--nti Mukama Yesu Kristo yabonaabona mu kifo ky'aboonoonyi era ku lwabwe, era asobola okulokola bonna abamwesiga. Lwaki, kino kye kituufu ekisinga omukisa abantu kye baali balagiddwa okukkiriza; amazima agasinga okusaanira, agasinga okusanyusa, agasinga okuba aga Katonda agaali gateekeddwa mu maaso g'ebirowoozo by'abantu abafa. Nkuwa amagezi okugalowoozaako nnyo, era onoonye ekisa n'okwagala ebigirimu. Yiga ku Bawandiisi b'Enjiri abana, yiga ku bbaluwa za Pawulo, olyoke olabe oba obubaka si bwa kukkirizibwa nnyo n'olyoka oleeteddwa okubukkiriza.

Ekyo bwe kitakola, kale lowooza ku muntu wa Yesu Kristo--lowooza ku oyo gw'ali, ne kye yakola, ne w'ali, ne ky'ali. Oyinza otya okumubuusabuusa? Bukambwe okutaresiga Yesu ow'amazima ennaku zonna. Talina kye yakola okusaanira okubuusibwabuusibwa; wabula, kyandibadde kyangu okumwesiga. Lwaki omukomerera ku musaalaba nate olw'obutakkiriza? Kino si kwe kumutikkira engule ey'amaggwa nate, n'okumuwandira amalusu nate? Ki! ye tasaana kwesigwa? Kuvvoola ki okusinga kuno abaserikale kwe baamufukako? Baamufuula omujulirwa eyattibwa; naye ggwe omufuula omulimba--kino kibi nnyo okusingako. Tobuuza nti nnyinza ntya okukkiriza? Naye ddamu ekibuuzo ekirala--Oyinza otya obutakkiriza?

Ebintu bino bwe bitaakuyambe n'ekimu, kale waliwo ekitali kituufu ku ggwe kyonna, era ekigambo kyange eky'enkomerero kwe kuno, weewaayo eri Katonda! Okusosola oba amalala ge gasibuka obutakkiriza buno. Omwoyo wa Katonda aggyewo obulabe bwo akufuule omuwulire. Oli mujeemu, omujeemu ow'amalala, era kyova totakkiriza Katonda wo. Leka obujeemu bwo; suula ebyokulwanyisa byo; weewaayo awatali kwewozaawoza, weewaayo eri Kabaka wo. Nzikiriza nti tewali mwoyo gwali guyimusizza emikono gyagwo mu kwekiluma, ne gukaaba nti, “Mukama, neewaddeyo,” naye okukkiriza ne kutagufuukira kyangu oluvannyuma lwa bbanga ttono. Kiva ku olwokubanga okyalina oluyombo ne Katonda, era osalawo okukola by'oyagala n'engeri yo ggwe, noolwekyo toyinza kukkiriza. “Muyinza mutya okukkiriza,” Kristo bwe yagamba, “mmwe abaweebwa ekitiibwa buli omu okuva ku munne?” Amalala ag'obwewulize gazaala obutakkiriza. Weewaayo, ai omuntu. Weewaayo eri Katonda wo, olwo n'olyoka okkiriza Omulokozi wo mu ngeri ennungi. Omwoyo Omutukuvu kaakano akolere naawe mu kyama naye n'amaanyi, akuleete mu kaseera kano kennyini okukkiriza Mukama Yesu! Amiina.

Bw'oba mu kunakuwala, weetaaga kwegatta ku bantu ba Katonda, obuuze katono, ojja kuvumbula nti abamu ku batukuvu nabo baali mu kunakuwala okwenkanako ebiseera ebimu, era bajja kusanyuka okukubuulira engeri Mukama gye yabawonyaamu. Bw'onoowuliriza omu ku omu ku abo abagezesezza ekigambo kya Katonda, ne bakikakasa, Omwoyo wa Katonda ajja kukuluŋŋamya okukkiriza. Towuliranga ku Muwafirika eyategeezebwa omuweereza wa Katonda nti amazzi oluusi gakaluba nnyo omuntu n'ayinza okugatambulirako? Yagamba nti yakkiriza ebintu bingi omuweereza bye yamubuulira; naye ekyo teyandikikkirizza n'akatono. Bwe yajja mu Bungereza, lwali lunaku olw'obutiti n'alaba omugga nga gukutte, naye teyagenda kugutambulirako. Yamanya nti gwali mugga muwanvu, era yakakasa nti yandizikiridde bwe yandigenzeko. Teyayinza kusendebwa kutambula ku mazzi agakutte okutuusa mikwano gye n'abalala bangi bwe baagatambulirako; olwo n'akkirizibwa, ne yeesiga awo abalala we baali batambulidde awatali kabi. Bw'otyo, bw'onoolaba abalala nga bakkiriza Omwana gw'Endiga ogwa Katonda, n'olaba essanyu n'emirembe byabwe, naawe ojja kutwalibwa mpola mpola okukkiriza. Obumanyirivu bw'abalala y'emu ku ngeri za Katonda ez'okutuyamba okukkiriza. Oteekwa oba okukkiriza Yesu oba okufa; tewali ssuubi lirala eri ggwe wabula mu ye. Enteekateeka esinga obulungi y'eno--tegeera obuyinza obw'olagirwako okukkiriza, era kino kijja kukuyamba nnyo eri okukkiriza. Obuyinza si bwange, kubanga wandisobodde okubugaana. Naye olagirwa okukkiriza ku buyinza bwa Katonda yennyini. Akulagira okukkiriza Yesu Kristo, era toteekwa kugaana kugondera Omutonzi wo. Omukulu w'abakozi ab'ekkolero erimu yali awulidde enjiri emirundi mingi, naye yali atawaanyizibwa okutya nti ayinza obutajja eri Kristo. Mukama we omulungi lumu n'aweereza kaadi mu kkolero--"Jjangu mu nnyumba yange amangu ddala ng'omulimu guweddeko." Omukulu w'abakozi n'ajja ku luggi lwa mukama we, mukama we n'afuluma, n'ayogera n'obukambwe obutono, "Oyagala ki, Yokaana, okuntawaanya mu kiseera kino? Omulimu guweddeko, olina buyinza ki okuba wano?" "Ssebo," n'addamu, "nnafunye kaadi okuva gy'oli nga egamba nti njije ng'omulimu guweddeko." "Otegeeza nti olwokubanga ofunye kaadi okuva gy'ndi noolwekyo osaana okwambuka mu nnyumba yange n'ompita ebiseera by'emirimu nga biweddeko?" "Kale, Ssebo," omukulu w'abakozi n'addamu, "sikutegeera, naye kirabika gye ndi nti, olwokubanga wantumidde, nnalina obuyinza okujja." "Yingira, Yokaana," mukama we n'agamba, "nnina obubaka obulala bwe njagala okukusomera," n'atuula n'asoma ebigambo bino: "Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza." "Olowooza nti oluvannyuma lw'obubaka nga buno okuva eri Kristo oyinza okuba nga okyamye okujja gy'ali?" Omuntu omunaku n'akiraba amangu ddala, n'akkiriza Mukama Yesu okutuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo, kubanga yategeera nti yalina obuyinza obulungi n'obukakafu okukkiriza. Naawe bw'otyo, ggwe omwoyo omunaku! Olina obuyinza obulungi okujja eri Kristo, kubanga Mukama yennyini akulagira okumwesiga. Ekyo bwe kitakuzaaliramu kukkiriza, lowooza ku ekyo ky'oteekwa okukkiriza--nti Mukama Yesu Kristo yabonaabona mu kifo ky'aboonoonyi era ku lwabwe, era asobola okulokola bonna abamwesiga. Lwaki, kino kye kituufu ekisinga omukisa abantu kye baali balagiddwa okukkiriza; amazima agasinga okusaanira, agasinga okusanyusa, agasinga okuba aga Katonda agaali gateekeddwa mu maaso g'ebirowoozo by'abantu abafa. Nkuwa amagezi okugalowoozaako nnyo, era onoonye ekisa n'okwagala ebigirimu. Yiga ku Bawandiisi b'Enjiri abana, yiga ku bbaluwa za Pawulo, olyoke olabe oba obubaka si bwa kukkirizibwa nnyo n'olyoka oleeteddwa okubukkiriza. Ekyo bwe kitakola, kale lowooza ku muntu wa Yesu Kristo--lowooza ku oyo gw'ali, ne kye yakola, ne w'ali, ne ky'ali. Oyinza otya okumubuusabuusa? Bukambwe okutaresiga Yesu ow'amazima ennaku zonna. Talina kye yakola okusaanira okubuusibwabuusibwa; wabula, kyandibadde kyangu okumwesiga. Lwaki omukomerera ku musaalaba nate olw'obutakkiriza? Kino si kwe kumutikkira engule ey'amaggwa nate, n'okumuwandira amalusu nate? Ki! ye tasaana kwesigwa? Kuvvoola ki okusinga kuno abaserikale kwe baamufukako? Baamufuula omujulirwa eyattibwa; naye ggwe omufuula omulimba--kino kibi nnyo okusingako. Tobuuza nti nnyinza ntya okukkiriza? Naye ddamu ekibuuzo ekirala--Oyinza otya obutakkiriza? Ebintu bino bwe bitaakuyambe n'ekimu, kale waliwo ekitali kituufu ku ggwe kyonna, era ekigambo kyange eky'enkomerero kwe kuno, weewaayo eri Katonda! Okusosola oba amalala ge gasibuka obutakkiriza buno. Omwoyo wa Katonda aggyewo obulabe bwo akufuule omuwulire. Oli mujeemu, omujeemu ow'amalala, era kyova totakkiriza Katonda wo. Leka obujeemu bwo; suula ebyokulwanyisa byo; weewaayo awatali kwewozaawoza, weewaayo eri Kabaka wo. Nzikiriza nti tewali mwoyo gwali guyimusizza emikono gyagwo mu kwekiluma, ne gukaaba nti, "Mukama, neewaddeyo," naye okukkiriza ne kutagufuukira kyangu oluvannyuma lwa bbanga ttono. Kiva ku olwokubanga okyalina oluyombo ne Katonda, era osalawo okukola by'oyagala n'engeri yo ggwe, noolwekyo toyinza kukkiriza. "Muyinza mutya okukkiriza," Kristo bwe yagamba, "mmwe abaweebwa ekitiibwa buli omu okuva ku munne?" Amalala ag'obwewulize gazaala obutakkiriza. Weewaayo, ai omuntu. Weewaayo eri Katonda wo, olwo n'olyoka okkiriza Omulokozi wo mu ngeri ennungi. Omwoyo Omutukuvu kaakano akolere naawe mu kyama naye n'amaanyi, akuleete mu kaseera kano kennyini okukkiriza Mukama Yesu! Amiina.

fields.title: Okuzaalibwa Obuggya n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu
fields.body_html:
OKUZAALIBWA OBUGGYA N'OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU

KISAANA MUZAALIBWE OBUGGYA.” Ekigambo kino ekya Mukama waffe Yesu kirabise ng'ekimyuka omuliro mu kkubo ery'abangi, ng'ekitala ekisowole ekya kerubi ku mulyango gwa Paradiso. Baweddemu essuubi, kubanga enkyukakyuka eno esukka amaanyi gaabwe gonna. Okuzaalibwa obuggya kuva waggulu, era noolwekyo tekuli mu buyinza bw'ekitonde. Kaakano, kiri wala nnyo okuva mu birowoozo byange okwegaana, oba okukweka, amazima olw'okutondawo essanyu ery'obulimba. Nkkiriza awatali kubuusabuusa nti okuzaalibwa obuggya kwa magero, era nti tekuyinza kukolebwa omwonoonyi ku bubwe. Kyandibadde kuyamba kutono eri omusomi wange singa mbadde mubi okutuuka we nnyinza okugezaako okumusanyusa nga mmusendasenda okugaana oba okwerabira ekyo ekitalina kubuusabuusa.

Naye tekyewuunyisa nti essuula y'emu Mukama waffe mw'akoleramu okulangirira kuno okugazi era nammwo mwe muli ebigambo ebisingayo obw'olwatu ku bulokozi obuva mu kukkiriza? Soma essuula ey'okusatu mu Njiri ya Yokaana, era toziyimirira ku bigambo byayo eby'olubereberye byokka. Kya mazima nti olunyiriri olw'okusatu lugamba nti:

Yesu n'amuddamu n'amugamba nti, Mazima mazima nkugamba nti, Omuntu bw'atazaalibwa nate, tayinza kulaba bwakabaka bwa Katonda.

Naye ate, ennyiriri ez'ekkumi n'ennya n'ekkumi n'ettaano zoogera nti:

Era nga Musa bwe yayimusa omusota mu ddungu, bw'atyo n'Omwana w'omuntu bw'ateekwa okuyimusibwa: buli amukkiririza aleme okuzikirira, naye abeere n'obulamu obutaggwaawo.

Olunyiriri olw'ekkumi n'omunaana luddamu okuyigiriza kwe kumu mu ngeri egazi ennyo nti:

Amukkiriza tasalirwa musango: naye atakkiriza asaliddwa dda omusango, kubanga takkirizza linnya lya Mwana wa Katonda eyazaalibwa omu yekka.

Kya lwatu eri buli musomi nti ebigambo bino byombi biteekwa okukkiriziganya, kubanga byava mu kamwa ke kamu, era biwandiikiddwa ku lupapula lwe lumu olwaluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo. Lwaki tweteekera ekizibu we kitasaanidde kubaawo? Singa ekigambo ekimu kitukakasa nti okulokolebwa kwetaagisa ekintu, Katonda yekka ky'ayinza okuwa, ate ekirala ne kitukakasa nti Mukama anaatulokola nga tumaze okukkiriza Yesu, kale tuyinza okusalawo awatali kubuusabuusa nti Mukama anaawa abo abakkiriza byonna ebyalangirirwa okwetaagisa mu bulokozi. Mu butuufu, Mukama azaala obuggya bonna abakkiriza Yesu; era okukkiriza kwabwe bwe bujulizi obusinga obw'amaanyi nti bazaaliddwa obuggya.

Twesiga Yesu ku ekyo kye tutayinza kwekolera ffe: singa kyandibadde mu buyinza bwaffe, kale twali twetaaga ki okumutunuulira? Ffe kya kukkiriza, Mukama y'atulonga obuggya. Taakkirize ku lwaffe, era naffe tetulina kukolera Mukama mulimu gwa kutuzaala buggya. Kitumala okugondera ekiragiro eky'ekisa; Mukama y'akola omulimu gw'okutuzaala obuggya mu ffe. Oyo eyayinza okutuukira ddala okufiira ku musaalaba ku lwaffe, ayinza era anaatuwa ebintu byonna bye twetaaga olw'obukuumi bwaffe obw'emirembe gyonna.

“Naye okukyusibwa kw'omutima okulokola gwe mulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.” Na kino nakyo kya mazima ddala, era kireme okutuvaako okukibuusabuusa oba okukyerabira. Naye omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwa kyama era gwa kyewuunyo, era gusobola kutegeerwa mu bibala byagwo byokka. Waliwo ebyama ebikwata ku kuzaalibwa kwaffe okw'omubiri, gye kyandibadde kya bwenkanya kubi okwagala okuvumbula: n'okusingira ddala mu mirimu emitukuvu egy'Omwoyo gwa Katonda. “Empewo ekunta gy'eyagala, n'owulira eddoboozi lyayo, naye tomanyi gy'eva newakubadde gy'egenda; bw'atyo bwe buli buli azaalibwa Omwoyo.” Naye kino kyokka tukimanyi--omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw'ekyama teguyinza kuba nsonga ya kugaana kukkiriza Yesu, Omwoyo ogwo gwennyini gwe gujulira.

Singa omuntu alagirwa okusiga mu nnimiro, tayinza kwewola olw'okulagajjala kwe ng'agamba nti okusiga kwandibadde kwa bwereere okuggyako nga Katonda aleetedde ensigo okumera. Teyandibadde na nsonga ntuufu okulagajjalira okulima kubanga amaanyi ga Katonda ag'ekyama gokka ge gayinza okuleeta amakungula. Tewali n'omu aziyizibwa mu mirimu egya bulijjo egy'obulamu olw'ekigambo nti Mukama bw'atazimba nnyumba, abagizimba bakolera bwereere. Kya kakasa nti tewali muntu akkiriza Yesu aliraba nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu agaanye okukolera mu ye: mu butuufu, okukkiriza kwe bwe bukakafu nti Omwoyo amaze dda okukola mu mutima gwe.

Katonda akola mu kulabirira kwe, naye abantu tebatuula bwereere olw'ekyo. Tebandisobodde kutambula awatali maanyi ga Katonda agabawa obulamu n'amaanyi, kyokka bagenda mu maaso mu kkubo lyabwe awatali kubuusabuusa; amaanyi nga gaweebwa buli lunaku Oyo alina omukka gwabwe mu mukono gwe, era ow'amakubo gaabwe gonna. Bwe kityo bwe kiri mu kisa. Twenenya ne tukkiriza, wadde nga tetwandisobodde kukola na kimu ku ebyo singa Mukama teyatusobozesa. Tuva mu kibi ne twesiga Yesu, olwo ne tutegeera nti Mukama atukoledde okwagala n'okukola ng'okusiima kwe okulungi bwe kuli. Kya bwereere okwefuula nti waliwo ekizibu ekituufu mu nsonga eno.

Amazima agamu agazibu okunnyonnyola mu bigambo, mu bulamu obw'okwennyini gaba magangu ddala. Tewali njawulo wakati w'amazima nti omwonoonyi akkiriza, n'amazima nti okukkiriza kwe akufunira mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Obusirusiru bwokka bwe buyinza okuleeta abantu okwesamba mu nsonga ennyangu ng'emyoyo gyabwe giri mu kabi. Tewali muntu ayinza kugaana kuyingira lyato ery'okulokola kubanga tamanyi buzito bw'emibiri; era n'omuntu alumwa enjala tayinza kugaana kulya okutuusa lw'ategeera enkola yonna ey'okugaaya emmere. Bw'oba, ggwe omusomi wange, toyagala kukkiriza okutuusa lw'oyinza okutegeera ebyama byonna, tolokolebwe n'akatono; ate bw'okkiriza ebizibu bye weeyiiya bikuziyize okukkiriza okusonyiyibwa okuva mu Mukama era Omulokozi wo, olizikirira mu musango ogunaakusaanira ddala. Toweetta mu mwoyo olw'omululu ogw'okuwakana ku nsonga enzibu ennyo ez'okulowooza.
